Conceptual Art Director

Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Art Director with a passion for Generative AI to create bold, high-performing digital campaigns for top global brands. In this role, you’ll partner with copywriters, strategists and creatives to deliver concept-driven ideas across social media, web, video, and more—bringing big ideas to life with strong art direction and design execution.

You’ll thrive in a collaborative, globally distributed team and contribute to work that’s not only creatively exciting but also strategically sharp. This is a role for someone who can think big, execute beautifully, and bring a deep understanding of design to everything they do.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with copywriters and strategists to develop compelling creative campaigns across digital-first channels (social, web, video) with the ability to stretch into ATL (TV, print, OOH).
  • Lead art direction for creative campaigns and video concepts, providing visual direction from ideation through final execution.
  • Design or direct the creation of digital assets, mood boards, layouts, and visual frameworks that bring brand narratives to life.
  • Integrate AI-assisted assets into workflows while maintaining brand integrity and emotional impact.
  • Contribute to brand storytelling by developing concept-led brand systems and integrated creative ideas.
  • Build and present creative decks that clearly communicate concepts and strategy to customers.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and other creatives across time zones.
  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously, consistently delivering on time, on budget, and to the highest quality.
  • Help push creative boundaries, championing fresh ideas and evolving Superside’s conceptual capabilities.
  • Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to understand goals and deliver work that drives results.
  • Contribute to a culture of excellence, experimentation, and continuous creative growth.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in concept-driven roles within creative agencies or fast-paced in-house teams.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing concept-first thinking and excellent art direction across digital platforms.
  • Proficient in using AI tools as part of a thoughtful and intentional creative workflow.
  • Passion for creativity and a strong eye for design, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence presenting ideas to customers and internal teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with experience juggling multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Growth mindset and curiosity, always seeking new tools, trends, and ways to improve your craft.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing and performance creative principles.
  • A collaborative and inclusive approach to working with diverse teams and perspectives.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

jobs.description:
Remote Manager (Director) Partnerships DACH (m/f/d)

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

The Role

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types

  • Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

  • Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

  • Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

Lead Employment Counsel

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Employment Counsel to be the first line of legal support for our People team. This person will advise directly on employment matters, manage our key legal and HR vendor relationships, and reduce our reliance on outside counsel. This is a hands-on, embedded role for an attorney who wants to operate as a trusted business partner, not a gatekeeper.

What you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first line of support for employment legal questions, resolving most matters directly rather than routing them to outside counsel.

  • Partner with each People Business Partner to advise on employee relations, performance management, terminations, leaves, and accommodations. Manage severe employee relations cases directly.

  • Own the Remote.com relationship, including contract terms, service levels, escalations, and ongoing performance.

  • Own the external legal counsel relationship, including a clear evaluation of scope, spend, and who we engage with

  • Partner with Legal and Finance on cross-functional projects involving employment law, compliance, or spend.

  • Ensure compliance with employment law across every jurisdiction where Camunda operates, with particular depth in the DACH region. Find opportunities to reduce risk or balance risk with business value.

  • Identify and adopt AI tools that make legal support to the People team faster and more effective.

  • Track and reduce external counsel spend against a clear baseline.

What you bring:

  • J.D. or equivalent law degree, with active bar admission in at least one jurisdiction.

  • 8+ years of employment law experience, including significant in-house experience at a global, multi-jurisdiction company.

  • Deep, current knowledge of DACH employment law (works councils, termination protections, co-determination), plus broad experience across other global jurisdictions.

  • Experience managing outside counsel and HR vendor relationships, including EOR platforms such as Remote or similar.

  • A track record of advising HR and People teams directly, and translating legal risk into practical, business-pragmatic guidance.

  • Strong judgment and comfort making autonomous calls without escalating every matter to outside counsel.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve legal or compliance workflows.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to build trust across People, Legal, and Finance.

Enterprise Customer Success Manager
Job Title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
Type: Full-time
Location: Paris 
 
What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 
 
The Role

We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.

As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.

The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.

If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.


What do we want to achieve together?

First chapter — land it (through the migration)

  • Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.

  • Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme ownership — you hold the plan, not someone else's.

  • Lead through the group's regional supervisors. Your closest allies on the ground are the group's regional supervisors — their people, not ours, covering each part of the network. You set the plan, the cadence and the standards with them, and you make the programme theirs to succeed at, in an organisation where nobody reports to you. On our side, you can draw on INFINIT's Operations Agents for setup, configuration and data work.

  • Run the product feedback loop. You are the single channel between the group and our Product & Engineering teams. You separate a genuine platform gap from a habit dressed up as a requirement, write requirements engineers can act on, and hold a prioritised backlog the customer recognises as theirs.

  • Protect the date without breaking trust. Hundreds of agencies migrate inside a single quarter with a hard cut-over. You are the one who sees the risk early, says so, and gets it fixed.

    • Second chapter — grow it (the long game)

  • Drive adoption and value, agency by agency. You track usage across the network, spot the sites that are behind, understand why, and fix it. You know which agencies love us and which ones are quietly not using us — and you never learn that from a dashboard alone.

  • Be the group's business partner, not their vendor contact. You understand their stock turn, their margin per vehicle, their lead conversion. You bring them insight they don't have, and you are credible with agency managers, with the DSI and with general management alike.

  • Own the commercial outcome. Retention and renewal of our largest contract, plus the expansion of INFINIT across the group — above all the deployment of our AI agents into their day-to-day operations.

  • Turn one account into a model. What you learn becomes INFINIT's enterprise dealer-group playbook.


    • What do you need to be successful in this role?

Marketing Communications Manager (B2B)

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary Range: €55K - €68K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

We're looking for a Marketing Communications Manager (B2B) who spans brand and growth marketing - someone versatile enough to move across content and product marketing, but with a clear centre of gravity in storytelling and strategic content production. You'll be part of a hybrid team where everyone covers more than one surface, and you'll have real ownership across multiple workstreams from day one to do whatever brings the most impact to reach our company goals.

The core of the job is making Almedia’s expertise and brand impossible to ignore in the space of gaming, advertising, technology, data, consumer apps, scale-ups and growth companies, so we get noticed by partners. That means finding the signal inside a technically complex business, turning it into content that actually moves people and deals, and then making sure it reaches the right personas in the right way. The measure of success is simple: how many more people know about Almedia, and how many stakeholders reach out to us because of our initiatives and the collateral we publish, rather than the other way around.

You'll report to our Global B2B Marketing Lead, work closely with PR and event managers, and collaborate with the growth team and C-Suite to continuously develop the Almedia brand.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Drive flagship brand campaigns. Own brand campaigns end to end - from identifying the high-impact opportunity and building the story, through to channel rollout and measurement. You decide what gets done, made and why. The standard is that it needs to be worth actioning, not just worth reading.

  • Leverage the team. Find ways to use our 150+ people to source content and amplify the message, without adding to their workload, but making their contributions count.

  • Build and distribute the growth content engine. Develop white papers sourced from our own data, case studies with real customer evidence, a monthly newsletter, and campaign assets for our flagship events, then own how they get out into the world. Identify the right channels, the right timing, and the right formats to make sure what gets made actually gets read. Track whether it's working and adjust.

  • Make sales self-sufficient. Build a product marketing toolkit for Freecash and Link, including messaging, one-pagers, pitch decks, and case studies, so that active deals and existing partnerships use the collateral instead of improvised slides. Track adoption and close the loop with the sales team on what's actually working.

  • Grow Almedia's presence. Turn the work you produce into reputation. The white papers, case studies, and campaign assets you create should be doing double duty, showing up in pitches, feeding into event narratives, and giving Almedia a clear point of view in a crowded market. The goal is that people in our industry know who we are and what we stand for, because the content speaks for itself.

  • Bring stakeholders along. Get internal buy-in for marketing initiatives from people who have other priorities. Whether it's sourcing a customer story from sales, getting a C-Suite perspective into a white paper, or aligning leadership on a campaign direction, you know how to make marketing a team effort without making it someone else's problem.

  • Support event planning and execution. Organise the conferences, sponsorships, and brand activations Almedia shows up to — logistics, booth setup, timelines, vendor coordination.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Month 1: Learn the product suite, the sales motion, and the content gaps. Audit existing collateral and identify what's missing or not being used. Get onboarded on the brand activities and support planned activations and events with narrative and copy.

  • Month 2: Ship your first white paper or flagship content asset and own its distribution. Conceptualise a brand or growth-focused event.

  • Month 3: Own the growth side of the social and website content calendar. Have a working content calendar in place, and a feedback loop running between you, sales, and leadership on what's resonating. By this point you're running on your own.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strategic content thinking. You approach content as a lever, not a deliverable. You ask what outcome a piece needs to drive before you write a word, and you're just as focused on distribution and measurement as you are on the writing itself. You're not here to fill a content calendar, you're here to shift how our market thinks about Almedia.

  • C2-level B2B writing. You can take a complex product or technical concept and produce something a busy CMO would read in full. Long-form assets, white papers, case studies, product one-pagers, come out publish-ready, not draft-ready. You self-edit hard and don't need someone to rewrite your work.

  • Story sourcing instinct. You know how to find the interesting thing inside a business: the data point that reframes a conversation, the customer story that proves the value prop, the internal perspective that hasn't been said publicly yet. You don't wait for a brief to hand you a story.

  • Product marketing fundamentals. You've built or maintained messaging frameworks, value propositions, and sales collateral before. You understand how B2B buyers think and what makes a case study actually useful in a sales conversation versus something that sits in a Notion folder.

  • Project ownership. Complex projects, a website section, a flagship report, a product launch toolkit, run on your calendar, not someone else's. You track dependencies, manage vendors or freelancers when needed, and communicate proactively when something is off track.

  • Bonus: German or Turkish language skills for PR coordination.

  • Bonus: Background in adtech, mobile gaming, or performance marketing.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: A piece of content doesn't leave your hands until it's genuinely good, and neither does its distribution or results. You take accountability for the full outcome, not just your section of it.

  • Take Initiative: You spot the gap or content opportunity before someone points it out and you've already started filling it.

  • Move Fast: You run multiple workstreams in parallel, make decisions with incomplete information, and ship rather than polish indefinitely.

  • Focus on Impact: You know which content will move the needle and which is just noise, and you spend your time on the former. If something isn't working, you change course.

  • Raise the Bar: You push back when a brief is vague, when a case study is too generic, or when a deck doesn't actually say anything. High standards aren't a personality trait here, they're the job.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

The position will require leadership that spans go-to-market strategy development, managing Mid Market Account Executives and key account planning program development and implementation, executive relationship mapping and alignment, cultivating deep levels of trust and product co-creation, balancing short term with long term sales cycles and collaborating extensively cross-functionally to bring to bear product, marketing, support, success, solution engineering and channel onto our highest growth potential accounts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Building & Hiring: Continue to build, recruit, and coach the France Mid-Market Sales Team in close partnership with recruiting resources and regional leadership.

  • Team Leadership: Direct leadership of Mid-Market Account Executives (AEs), while aligning cross-functional support roles (BDRs, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Field Marketing).

  • Execution & Revenue Growth: Drive sales growth through operational rigor, consistent pipeline generation, tight sales execution, and targeted regional go-to-market initiatives.

  • Process & Methodology: Implement and drive best practices using the company’s sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) across pipeline management, forecasting, and account expansion.

  • Regional Strategy: Execute sales strategies tailored to the French mid-market segment and mid-sized enterprises (ETI), ensuring fast sales cycles and quick customer time-to-value.

  • Deal Support: Act as an operational point of contact and dynamic "player-coach" to help close strategic mid-market deals and resolve operational roadblocks.

  • Governance: Ensure corporate policy and sales standards are consistently followed by the team.

  • Cadence & Rigor: Maintain a structured operational cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, 1-on-1 coaching sessions, deal reviews, and team meetings.

Desired Skills, Knowledge and Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of sales management experience in B2B SaaS/Tech, preceded by a strong track record as an individual contributor selling into mid-sized businesses.

  • Language skills: Fluency in French and English is required.

  • Mid-Market Focus: Proven success managing medium-length, high-velocity sales cycles (30–90 days) with a strong quarterly execution cadence.

  • Ecosystem Knowledge: Solid understanding of the French IT, Cloud, and Cybersecurity landscape (mid-market / ETI segment).

  • Technical Aptitude: Experience or strong familiarity with cloud security, network performance, Zero Trust, SASE, and modern web architecture.

  • Sales Rigor: Mastery of sales methodologies, CRM hygiene (Salesforce), pipeline generation strategies, and accurate quarterly forecasting.

  • Leadership Style: Hands-on leader capable of coaching, developing early-to-mid career AEs, and driving high team energy and performance.

Compensation

  • For France based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €178,000 - €244,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. jobs.description:
Senior Android Developer (f/m/d)

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Kotlin & Android Internals Expertise: You will own the core development and optimization of the adjoe Ads SDK, which runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. We are looking for someone with 8+ years of Android experience (or 3+ years specifically in SDK/library development) who works primarily with Kotlin and has a deep understanding of Android lifecycles, ProGuard/R8, and multithreading to ensure zero tolerance for instability on millions of devices.

  • High-Performance Network Design: You will collaborate with backend teams to design APIs and capture behavioral signals that power 50 billion daily ML predictions. You need a strong track record in API design, maintaining strict backward compatibility for thousands of external integrators, and working with high-performance networking protocols like gRPC, Protobuf, Wire, and OkHTTP.

  • Resource-Constrained Optimization: You will ensure every ad impression feels native and fast while participating in 120 million daily auctions. You must know how to design for minimal footprint, optimizing battery impact and memory usage, as your code executes directly inside someone else’s app and device.

  • Data-Driven Observability: You will monitor, debug, and maintain SDK reliability at scale across millions of global users. You will leverage observability and data tools—including Sentry, Kibana, and AWS (S3, QuickSight, Athena)—to track errors, investigate SDK behavior, and turn raw data into clear engineering decisions.

  • Build Automation & Delivery: You will maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee efficient, reliable SDK delivery. This requires hands-on experience with Gradle and GitLab CI to automate the testing, building, and packaging of our mobile libraries.

  • Plus – AdTech & Low-Level Systems: It is a major plus if you bring experience in ad-tech or programmatic advertising (aligning products with IAB specifications). Additionally, experience with NDK/JNI (C/C++ interop on Android) or parallel iOS development experience is highly valued to help support our cross-platform ecosystem.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.description:
SEO & AI Content Specialist

Why this role exists

At Pennylane, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are central to making our product easier to discover and understand, while helping us reach new customers.

We are looking for an SEO & AI Content Specialist to work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team. Your mission will be to produce, improve and scale high-quality content that drives non-branded organic traffic and conversions, while embedding AI thoughtfully into the way we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys writing, structuring, optimising, measuring and iterating. You are curious about the evolution of search and eager to explore how people discover products through search engines and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on advising their clients.

A few figures that illustrate our scale and ambition:

💻 More than 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane.

🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 More than 1,100 Pennylaners work across the company, representing more than 25 nationalities.

💰 More than €400 million raised since launch.

🌍 A remote-friendly, international culture as we continue to grow across Europe.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team and :

Build AI-powered content workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, first drafts and content optimisation, while maintaining a high editorial standard.

  • Design repeatable workflows, including briefs, quality checklists, templates and editorial guidelines.

  • Help scale content production efficiently without compromising relevance, accuracy or clarity.

Produce and optimise high-value SEO content

  • Write, update and improve SEO content, including articles, pillar pages and landing pages, to generate non-branded organic traffic and conversions.

  • Turn search intent into clear, useful and well-structured content for Pennylane’s audiences.

  • Run continuous optimisation initiatives, including content refreshes, consolidation, internal linking and on-page improvements.

  • Work with stakeholders across Growth to ensure content supports broader acquisition priorities.

Help develop our GEO approach

  • Build an understanding of the questions and prompts prospects use in AI-powered discovery tools.

  • Adapt content to help ensure Pennylane is accurately understood and discoverable across emerging AI search journeys.

  • Test content formats, structures and optimisation approaches that improve visibility in AI-generated answers — without compromising the experience for human readers.

  • Share learnings and contribute to shaping Pennylane’s evolving SEO and GEO playbook.

Make decisions with data

  • Monitor and prioritise work based on SEO performance signals, including visibility, rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, organic traffic and conversions.

  • Translate data into concrete, actionable recommendations.

  • Run experiments, measure their impact and iterate quickly and rigorously.

What you bring

  • You have initial, meaningful hands-on experience in SEO, ideally with published content you can share.

  • You are fluent in French, with strong writing and editing skills. You also have professional working proficiency in English.

  • You enjoy improving content and are motivated by the challenge of turning a good page into a high-performing one.

  • You take a pragmatic, data-informed approach: you form hypotheses, test them, measure outcomes and improve.

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow and are excited to deepen your practice.

  • You have a sharp eye for structure, clarity, accuracy and editorial quality.

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment and know how to focus on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.

🛠️ Tools and environment

You will work with tools such as Meteoria, Profound, Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Contentful and Notion.

What you can expect

  • A role with real room to propose, structure and improve how SEO works at Pennylane.

  • The opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of SEO, content, GEO and AI.

  • A demanding and supportive team that values execution, learning and sound judgement.

  • A direct and visible impact on organic acquisition and conversion.

  • A remote-friendly working environment, with access to home-office equipment, coworking options where relevant and regular opportunities to meet teammates in person.

  • Benefits that support flexibility, wellbeing, connection and growth. These may vary depending on your country, contract type and role.

📍 Location and working model

This role can be based in Paris on a hybrid basis, or remotely from anywhere in France.

🔎 Our recruitment process

All interviews are held remotely:

  1. An initial conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min).

  2. A conversation with the Hiring Manager (30 min).

  3. A case study and debrief with the Hiring Manager and a team member (1 hour).

  4. A final team-fit conversation with a Marketing Team Lead (30 min).

🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.

We know that some people are less likely to apply when they do not meet every single requirement. If this role sounds exciting and you believe you could make an impact, we would love to hear from you.

⚠️ Important information for candidates

Please apply only through Pennylane’s official channels. Our communications are sent from email addresses ending in @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com.

We will never ask you to make a payment or share financial information during the recruitment process.

Named Enterprise Account Executive

SLSQ327R41

Want to help solve the world's toughest problems with data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.

Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Data and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation their businesses need to gain first-mover advantage in today's ultra-competitive landscape.

We are looking for a creative, delivery-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to join the team in the Nordics to maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks Denmark. As an Account Executive, you know how to sell innovation and value to existing customers, identify new use cases and grow consumption and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating its value to customers and partners. You will be offered huge potential for career progression with the pace of the team's growth.

You will report to the Sales Director for Denmark and Norway.

The impact you will have:

  • You will co-develop a business plan, with your team and ecosystem partners, that accelerates customer success to exceed quarterly/annual consumption and booking goals
  • You will lead your team, customers and partners to identify impactful data and AI use cases whilst proving out their value on the Databricks Data Intelligence platform
  • You will implement the data and AI transformation goals of your customer through a combination of strategic partnerships, well scoped professional services, training and targeted Executive engagement
  • You will develop an understanding of technical product details and roadmap to build trust with executives and technical champions

What we look for:

  • Exstensive experience selling complex solutions to Enterprise Customers
  • You will have experience managing and leading complex, federated sales campaigns in major accounts
  • You will have experience working in Data, Cloud industries with some technical sales experience
  • Proof of exceeding sales quotas in high-growth Enterprise software companies
  • You will have experience driving consumption and commit-based engagement models and strategies working with professional services and training teams
  • You will have experience co-selling and scaling your business with Cloud Vendors (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams) and Global Solution Integrators (GSI)
  • Experience of building effective champions, collaborative teams and partnerships to support execution of your account / territory plan
  • Understanding of how to identify all key uses cases and buying centres in an opportunity to increase the impact of Databricks in an organisation
  • Experience of following robust sales methodologies and process, e.g. account planning, MEDDPICC, Value Selling and accurate forecasting
  • Bachelor's Degree or relevant work experience
  • Fluency in English is required

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Compliance

jobs.description:
Outbound GTM Engineer
Didomi helps organizations collect, store, and leverage user choices across multiple channels, increasing precision in marketing and advertising operations and building trust through transparent data practices.

Through a comprehensive software platform and premium support services, Didomi enables large corporations to optimize the collection and activation of user choice data, monitor vendor and tracker activity, and reduce compliance risk under global privacy regulations.

Following the 2025 acquisitions of Addingwell and Sourcepoint, Didomi has strengthened its end-to-end capabilities across consent, preferences, and data activation, bringing together server-side tagging and privacy technology to deliver experiences that improve performance, trust, and loyalty.

Active in 35 countries, Didomi supports over 2,000 clients across various sectors, including some of the world’s largest corporations, in building revenue-driving operations based on reliable and robust user choice data.

For more information, please visit www.didomi.io

The role

We are hiring a Outbound GTM Engineer to design, industrialize and run the engine behind our outbound acquisition. This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly the Revenue Operations Director working closely with the CRO, with a priority mandate to accelerate customer acquisition and expansion at the Group Level across North America and EMEA. You will own the data, the signals, the scoring and the automation that make our outreach sharper, faster and more scientific, and you will feed Sales with the best possible pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Clean and structure our TAM across all markets: deduplication, enrichment and segmentation.

  • Deliver exceptional-quality outreach data that every rep can rely on.

  • Centralize all buying and intent signals, and score every prospect and customer in the base.

  • Accelerate new business, expansion and cross-sell by feeding Sales the best data and intent, with a priority on Addingwell.

  • Automate the full lead workflow end to end: capture, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, routing and sequencing.

  • Improve prospection workflows across the main channels (email, LinkedIn, cold calling).

  • Build and scale a methodical, multichannel outbound machine (ICP, sequences, A/B testing, personalization at scale).

  • Improve inbound lead scoring and reactivate marketing-sourced leads into pipeline.

  • Track performance rigorously and iterate relentlessly on conversion rates.

What we're looking for

  • Outbound track record: you have built an outbound machine from scratch and can quantify its impact (pipeline, ARR, conversion rates).

  • Lead workflow automation: you automate capture, enrichment, scoring, routing and sequencing, and you are comfortable with ops tools, APIs, webhooks and no-code / low-code.

  • Tooling mastery: hands-on with ZoomInfo, lemlist and a modern CRM.

  • Data and signal mindset: you turn intent signals into prioritized, high-quality lists.

  • Copywriting and sequencing: messaging that converts, tested at scale.

  • International reach: fluent English and the ability to operate across North America and EMEA.

  • A scientific, automation-first operator: systematic, analytical, resilient, and fully accountable for your numbers.

Nice to have

  • Experience in adtech / martech, or around server-side tagging (Addingwell relevance).

  • Familiarity with privacy and consent (Didomi relevance).

Tools you'll use

ZoomInfo, Clay, Lemlist and Salesforce, alongside the enrichment and automation stack you will help shape.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive, Health Plans
jobs.description:
Customer Success Executive, Health Plans

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Customer Success Executive to support customers in our Health Plans segment, one of Carrot's most strategic channels. You will partner with health plan customers, serving as the primary point of contact for account, product, and clinical stakeholders to ensure Carrot remains a valued, ongoing part of the benefits they deliver to their members.

You'll work closely with these customers to promote retention, boost member engagement, and uphold excellent customer satisfaction. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to health plan stakeholders, clearly communicate the value of Carrot's offerings through payer-ready reporting on utilization, outcomes, and cost savings, and respond proactively to customer questions and requests while navigating the operating rhythms of large payer organizations.

As a Customer Success Executive dedicated to this segment, you will help shape how Carrot supports health plan customers, contributing to the playbooks and best practices that will scale as the channel grows, and playing a vital role in the growth and collaboration of our Customer Success team.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of health plan accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to plan account, product, and clinical stakeholders
  • Drive retention and renewal outcomes across your book of business, proactively identifying risks and building action plans that account for payer procurement and renewal cycles
  • Increase member engagement and program utilization across covered populations through data-informed recommendations and a regular cadence of business reviews
  • Present program value, outcomes, and cost-savings data to health plan leadership through clear storytelling, reporting, and executive-ready presentations
  • Partner cross-functionally with Health Plan Sales, Implementation, Business Intelligence, Legal & Compliance, and Member Success to deliver a seamless customer experience
  • Identify and support expansion opportunities within existing health plan relationships, including new lines of business and new populations, in partnership with the Health Plan Sales team
  • Contribute to the customer success playbooks, processes, and best practices for the Health Plans segment as the channel scales

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Built trusted, multi-threaded relationships across your portfolio of health plan customers, reflected in strong customer satisfaction and account health
  • Delivered consistent retention and renewal results across your book of business
  • Increased member engagement and program utilization across covered populations through proactive, data-informed recommendations
  • Established a regular cadence of business reviews and payer-ready reporting that clearly communicates value, outcomes, and cost savings to plan stakeholders
  • Contributed at least one scalable playbook, process improvement, or best practice adopted across the Health Plans segment

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's degree
  • 6+ years of professional experience working closely with external customers in a Customer Success, Account Management, or client services role in the health plan, payer, or healthcare benefits space
  • Experience working with or within health plans, with an understanding of how payers evaluate, launch, and manage partner programs
  • A track record of successfully managing complex, multi-stakeholder relationships and projects to deadline across simultaneous workstreams
  • Clear, empathetic communication skills, with comfort presenting to plan leadership and executive audiences
  • Enthusiasm for Carrot's mission and eagerness to become part of a collaborative, friendly, and dynamic team

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Existing relationships within national or regional health plans
  • Familiarity with payer operations such as clinical program integration, network strategy, or utilization and outcomes reporting
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM, managing tasks efficiently in a dynamic environment
  • Strong analytical, writing, and communication skills with sharp attention to detail
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity in a growing segment; highly organized, diligent, and self-motivated
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings and industry conferences

Why This Role Matters

Health plans are one of Carrot's most strategic channels: a single plan relationship can extend Carrot's care to entire covered populations, and Carrot's reputation in the payer market is earned account by account. The Customer Success Executive is the steward of these relationships, translating Carrot's clinical program and platform into measurable value for plans and the members they serve.

Every renewed partnership and every increase in member engagement means more people can access fertility and family-building care at scale. This role sits at the center of that impact, connecting customer outcomes in the payer market to Carrot's mission of providing care for everyone, everywhere.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $108,000-$130,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Technical Project Manager

Who we are ⬇️

Thinkific (TSX:THNC) is an award-winning learning commerce platform built for scale. By bringing together community, courses, and content with commerce, we power transformative learning experiences and give businesses everything they need to grow their revenue — all from one AI-powered platform. So far, our customers have generated over $3.7 billion in revenue and reached more than 200 million learners worldwide.

The culture we're building ⭐
We've been intentional about the culture we're building and are proud to be recognized as an award-winning culture—we’re a Certified Great Place to Work, one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers, BC Top Employers, and Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers for 2026 by Canada's Top 100!

Here’s what it means to work at Thinkific:

We're a high-performing team on a meaningful mission, and the way we work reflects that. Thinkers are customer-obsessed and ownership-driven — we talk to customers constantly, take full accountability for outcomes, and operate with a high degree of autonomy and trust. We care deeply for each other and believe the best ideas come from honest debate, real feedback, and diverse perspectives. It's a culture built on trust, exceptional work, and genuine respect for the people around us.

Who thrives here:

Thinkific may be the right place if you're energized by a fast-paced environment, enjoy high autonomy, and work well with ambiguity and change. You thrive in highly collaborative teams and make the people around you better. You're results-driven, take ownership without being asked, have hard conversations even when it's uncomfortable, and celebrate diverse perspectives. AI is a tool you embrace to move faster and think bigger.

Who doesn't thrive here:

If you prefer highly structured environments, need to wait for clear direction to move, dislike ambiguity and change, or find direct feedback uncomfortable, Thinkific may not be the right fit.

About the Role

Are you energized by complex, cross-functional challenges — the kind where you’re the person who brings clarity to ambiguity, momentum to high-stakes initiatives, and trust to every room you walk into? We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join us at Thinkific.

This role sits within our Program Management team inside Research & Development — a small but mighty team that operates at the heart of how Thinkific delivers. This team is a strategic force multiplier, owning complex end-to-end initiatives operating at the intersection of people, product, and AI-augmented delivery.

A note from the Hiring Manager

Hi! I am Afro, Manager of Program Management. I’m passionate about tackling complex cross-functional problems and excited for this person to join our team. This role is not just about organizing meetings and doing follow-ups. You will be highly engaged in owning projects end-to-end, solving interesting problems, and making meaningful decisions that contribute to Thinkific’s goals and our customers’ success. If this and a fast, AI-driven, and highly collaborative environment excites you, I can’t wait to meet you.

Your goal will be to drive end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives and raise the bar on how we ship. Here’s how you’ll accomplish this:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of high-stakes initiatives, leading programs that cut across engineering, product, data, and go-to-market teams from scoping through launch. You’ll define what “done” looks like and hold the organization accountable to it

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at every level — engineers, product managers, executives, and external partners. You’ll surface trade-offs clearly, manage competing priorities, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction

  • Leverage AI as a force multiplier. You already integrate AI tools into how you work — drafting status updates, synthesizing risk signals, generating meeting summaries and documentation, and accelerating decision-making

  • Translate business objectives into executable project plans by identifying dependencies, sequencing work intelligently, and proactively flagging when scope, timeline, or resources need to shift

  • Anticipate problems before they become blockers. You’ll build contingency plans, facilitate hard conversations early, and keep stakeholders informed

  • Define and reinforce standards for how we ship — quality gates, rollout plans, retrospectives, and post-mortems that actually lead to change

  • Own executive-level AI-assisted reporting with clear, opinionated status updates, risk dashboards, and decision-ready briefings

The person we have in mind likely:

  • Has 5+ years of experience in technical project management or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a software or SaaS environment

  • Is genuinely technical. They don’t need to write code, but understand how software is built and what makes an architecture decision hard

  • Is AI-fluent. They actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Notion AI, or similar) in their day-to-day work. They’re comfortable helping teams define guardrails for responsible AI use in workflows

  • Is a systems thinker who holds the whole picture — dependencies, risks, resource constraints, business context — while staying sharp on the details that matter most

  • Communicates with clarity and confidence. They write concisely, adapt their message to their audience, and can explain technical blockers in plain language

  • Is experienced with modern delivery frameworks (Agile, Scrum, Kanban)

  • Is data-informed and uses metrics to track progress and make decisions

  • Loves to learn and grow. They’ve found (and keep looking for) ways to level up their skills in this field, whether that’s through formal education, gaining professional experience, or maybe even building their own business

These things would also be nice, but we think you could learn them on the job:

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS or learning product company

  • Familiarity with evaluating and rolling out AI tooling within engineering or product teams

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification

  • Experience managing vendor relationships or third-party integrations at scale

The recruitment compensation range for this position is $93,100 – $116,400 – $139,700 CAD (this range is base salary only). Your specific compensation within this range is determined based on your job-related skills, knowledge, experience, and our internal equity assessment. The range is designed to capture the full journey from developing skills to excelling in the position. Most new hires start between the minimum and midpoint, which aligns with being fully capable in the role.

The Hiring Journey

  1. An exploratory call with our Talent team

  2. An impact-focused interview with Manager, Program Management

  3. Technical Stage

  4. Stakeholder Interview with VP, Research & Development

For a deeper look at our hiring process, what to expect during each step, AI guidelines, and how to prepare, visit our Candidate Hub ⭐

How we work with AI:

Thinkific is an AI-forward company. We use AI tools across all teams, and our approach to hiring is no different. We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our recruitment operations, and we're committed to being transparent about how. We automate where it drives efficiency, but every hiring decision is made by a person, and a high-touch, human candidate experience always comes first.

Candidates are welcome to use AI tools during the application process if desired.

Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more!

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging & Accessibility:

This is just our initial idea of who we’re looking for! At Thinkific, we know that people have unique career journeys. If your experience is close to what we’ve described but you feel that you might be missing a few of the requirements, please still apply! We believe in equal opportunity and are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging across every facet of our business.

We’re also committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview experience for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

What you can expect if you join Thinkific:

An amazing team of talented, passionate, and kind Thinkers. Together, we’ve built an incredible award-winning culture—we’re a Certified Great Place to Work and have been recognized on many Great Place to Work's Best Workplaces lists for Canada, Technology, Inclusion, Women, Mental Wellness, and more! We're also one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers, BC Top Employers, and Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers for 2026 by Canada's Top 100!
The chance to build, improve, and innovate on a platform that’s driving positive impact for thousands of businesses and millions of students around the world.

A competitive compensation package including base salary, equity, team-wide bonuses, and an Employee Share Purchase Plan.

Flexible Paid Time Off to maintain mental and physical health. Our team is encouraged to take a minimum 4 weeks of vacation, plus Thinker Holidays (extended long weekends in the summer) and time off for the December holiday season.

Health Benefits and Wellness: Comprehensive benefits starting on Day 1 include health, vision, and dental coverage for you and your family, $3,000 for mental health care, a short-term health plan, and an additional $900/year health or personal spending account. Plus, family friendly benefits include generous parental leave top-ups for up to 32 weeks, as well as fertility coverage and personalized return to work options.

3 Paid Volunteer Days each year to give back to your community and support the causes you care about.

Flexible Work. Choose to work from home from anywhere in Canada, at our Vancouver HQ, a co-working space, or anywhere there’s wifi for a change of scenery.

AI tools for every Thinker. We’re an AI-forward team, and every employee has access to the tools they need to work smarter, faster, and make a bigger impact.

⬆️ Learning & Growth. An annual $2,000 CAD Learn and Grow fund for conferences, seminars, or courses, plus training, mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.

A home office setup so you’re ready to succeed with a company-owned Macbook Pro and a budget to order a desk, chair, or any accessories to help you work comfortably and productively.

A place where you can bring your whole self to work. We know that different perspectives lead to amazing ideas, more innovation, and, ultimately, our success as a company. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, beliefs, identities, and statuses. Whoever you are—we can’t wait to meet you!
