jobs.title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role

We are seeking a Foundational Machine Learning Engineer for a high-impact greenfield opportunity to build our MLOps infrastructure from the ground up at Vestiaire Collective. While driving our AI authentication initiatives (deploying multi-model approaches including computer vision for luxury product authentication and counterfeit detection) will be your immediate focus, your long-term mission will be to scale foundational architecture across the entire marketplace. You will expand our ML capabilities to power broader domains, primarily focusing on search and recommendation systems, with future expansions into dynamic pricing and marketing technologies. Acting as the bridge among Applied Science, Data Platform, and Backend Engineering, you will design robust, decoupled architectures and spearhead the MLOps strategy with our Director of Data, prioritizing system maintainability, engineering hygiene, and the reliable deployment of complex models, ensuring all our ML models across the board deliver high-throughput, low-latency business impact.

What You Will Do

  • Short-Term Impact (First 6 Months): Partner closely with the Operations squads and Data Scientists to accelerate ML and RAG prototypes into resilient, production-ready code. You will directly integrate with the team to deploy, optimize, and scale heavy-width CV and VLM models focused on fraud detection and luxury product authentication, immediately improving our trust and safety ecosystem.

  • Mid-Term Foundation (MLOps Lifecycle & Infrastructure): Lead the end-to-end foundational groundwork of our ML lifecycle by designing robust systems for Data & Feature Management, Model Tracking & Registry, and Model Serving & Monitoring. You will scale infrastructure by automating continuous retraining pipelines that handle diverse deployment cadences (from daily fraud detection to weekly recommendations), design resilient multi-model architectures, and critically evaluate the technical overhead and TCO of our in-house tools against enterprise-grade platforms to ensure long-term resilience.

  • Long-Term Vision (Centralizing 360-Degree MLE Capabilities): Act as a pioneer and cornerstone hire for the ML engineering discipline at Vestiaire Collective, setting the technical standards to help scale the AI/ML organization. You will transition into a centralized foundational role, moving beyond single-squad operations to mentor the team and provide horizontal ML infrastructure support to multiple domains, including Search, Discovery, Pricing, Marketing, and Data Platforms.

Who You Are

Must-Haves:

  • Experience: 5-8+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering, specifically focused on building and scaling MLOps infrastructure and productionizing ML systems.

  • Production Infrastructure: Proven expertise in deploying low-latency, high-throughput ML inference services (using FastAPI, TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, or Ray Serve) across both classical lightweight and heavy-width ML models (PyTorch/TensorFlow). Strong preference for AWS (EKS, EC2, SageMaker) / Snowflake and Open Source ecosystems over GCP/Azure.

  • MLOps & Pipelines: Deep experience building automated, continuous model retraining pipelines to handle concept drift (ranging from daily to weekly cycles). You have orchestrated decoupled, multi-model AI architectures using tools like Airflow, Kubeflow, or Metaflow, and possess strong expertise in model registry and tracking tools like MLflow or Weights & Biases.

  • Feature Stores: Hands-on experience evaluating, building, or extensively leveraging online (Redis, DynamoDB) and offline (Snowflake, S3) Feature Stores in a production environment. Familiarity with frameworks like Feast or custom dbt-based pipelines is highly valued.

  • Strategic Builder Mindset: You are an analytical builder who thinks long-term. You can successfully evaluate TCO for bespoke internal systems versus enterprise tools, anticipate technical liabilities, and design robust architectures that handle unpredictable peak traffic surges.

  • Collaboration & Engineering Hygiene: Strong cross-functional communication skills. You excel at translating complex ML prototypes into highly scalable production code backed by strict version control, rigorous testing, and CI/CD best practices, seamlessly connecting data science innovation with backend engineering execution.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Relevant Domain Expertise: Background in E-commerce, Single-SKU Marketplaces, Search & Recommendation, Trust & Safety, or Counterfeit Detection.

  • Vision, Edge & Optimization: Hands-on experience with Vector Databases, Visual RAG pipelines, deploying Deep Learning VLM models, and optimizing models for edge computing or low-latency inference (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT).

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team.

We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager

  • Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first.

  • Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care.

  • Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team.

  • Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged.

  • Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority.

You should apply if...

  • You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes.

  • You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity.

  • You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you.

  • You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you.

What’s in it for me?

You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

jobs.description:
Product Manager (Protocol)

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

  • Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

  • Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

  • Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

  • Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

  • Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.

Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions.

Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices.

You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow
  • Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost
  • Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution
  • Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance
  • Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead
  • Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind
  • Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains
  • Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency
  • Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work
  • Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making
  • Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows
  • Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams

As a Missions Sales Director, you’ll lead sovereign satellite and ISR mission sales to government customers across Greece, Balkans and Eastern Mediterranean region, driving growth, trust, and long-term partnerships that advance ICEYE’s position as the defence-focused space ISR leader.

You will own the full sales cycle for Missions satellite programmes, from identifying and shaping opportunities to closing multi-year deals. By building strategic relationships with governments and key decision-makers, you will expand ICEYE’s presence in the region, deliver sustainable revenue growth, and ensure customer success through close collaboration across ICEYE’s Missions and Data lines of business.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own and drive regional revenue growth for ICEYE’s Missions business in your dedicated region

  • Identify, shape, qualify, and close sovereign satellite and ISR mission opportunities with government customers.

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with government stakeholders, defence organisations, and key decision-makers in the market.

  • Develop and manage a qualified sales pipeline, including capture plans, win strategies, and accurate forecasting.

  • Lead complex strategic sales processes, including opportunity reviews, bid or no-bid decisions, proposal coordination, and commercial positioning.

  • Collaborate across ICEYE’s Missions and Data lines of business to align customer needs, technical capabilities, and delivery plans.

  • Represent ICEYE in-market through customer meetings, industry events, and strategic stakeholder engagement.

  • Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning and decision-making.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of strategic sales or business development experience in the aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation, or related government technology sector.

  • 5+ years of international sales or export experience with complex solutions.

  • Experience selling to government customers, defence organisations, or public sector decision-makers.

  • Existing network across relevant government and government-related organisations across Greece, Balkans and Eastern Mediterranean.

  • Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR, or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR.

  • Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including lead qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping, and deal closure.

  • Professional working proficiency in Greek

  • Willingness to travel as required, primarily across the region and to Finland.

Nice to haves:

  • Previous military, defence, intelligence, or security-sector experience.

  • Experience producing capture plans and delivering against win strategies.

  • Track record of closing value-based sales with a strong focus on customer success.

  • Experience leading multi-department sales pursuits, gate reviews, bid processes, and competitive analysis.

  • Experience using Salesforce or another CRM.

  • Sales training in Miller Heiman, Korn Ferry, Shipley, or a similar methodology.

Application Process

  • Assessment

  • Recruiter interview

  • Peer interview

  • VP interview

  • References

  • CEO interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is 100 000 - 150 000 EUR per year, gross, dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us and we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.description:
Process Engineer (m/f/d)

About Rohlik Group

Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.

We believe the world needs a better food system: more sustainable, more inclusive, and bringing healthier, more personalised food to everyone. In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.

About the Team

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

 

What We Offer

  • Unlimited vacation days for a balanced work-life balance

  • Monthly vouchers: €45 tax-free (via become.1)

  • €20 monthly allowance towards internet costs

  • Knuspr Xtra account with 10% discount in the form of Knuspr Credits (cashback)

  • Great discounts via CorporateBenefits (fitness, travel, tickets, shopping, and much more)

  • Rohlik Vibe: an international team, flat hierarchies, and an informal culture where mistakes are seen as learning opportunities

 

What You'll Do

  • Identify improvement potential across the fulfillment network — on the floor, in the data, and with operations teams — wherever automation or process redesign can meaningfully improve cost, throughput, quality or safety

  • Own the business case for each opportunity: quantify throughput gains and labour impact, calculate payback period, prepare capex/opex estimates, and defend the investment to senior stakeholders

  • Own the full solution end to end, whatever form it takes — physical automation, software/control changes, or a combination of both

  • Standardise delivered work into reusable templates, playbooks and best practices that accelerate future projects

  • Lead implementation from design through testing, installation, integration and piloting, coordinating internal teams, vendors and contractors to deliver a working solution on site

  • Partner with Procurement and Operations across the full lifecycle — from requirements, RFIs/RFQs, vendor evaluation and commercial negotiation, through to a clean handover with documentation, SOPs, support processes and training for operational teams

  • Feed insights from delivered projects into the group automation roadmap and warehouse planning concepts

  • Support site and regional leadership by translating process and performance data into prioritised improvement opportunities

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Degree in engineering, a technical/analytical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics), or an equivalent completed vocational training (Ausbildung) / relevant hands-on experience

  • 3+ years of experience in warehouse automation (e.g., robotics, AMRs, AutoStore, sorters, conveyors, packing systems) and process improvement, including end-to-end project ownership from concept to handover

  • Strong analytical skills, capable of both spreadsheet business modeling and floor-level process evaluation

  • Proven project management ability to align Operations, Engineering, Finance, and external vendors

  • Strong negotiation and engagement skills with third-party vendors and contractors

  • Broad interest in both the hardware and software sides of automation

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken)

  • Willingness to spend regular time on-site at fulfillment centers

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with control logic, orchestration software or WMS integration

  • Working knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies

Strategic Value Engineer (Presales)

Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

 

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German, depending on territory.

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. Responsable Systèmes d'Information & Outils internes H/F

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers.

Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions s’imposent aujourd’hui comme des références sur le   marché :

N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

  • des outils qui ne communiquent pas toujours efficacement entre eux

  • des données encore partiellement silotées

  • certains processus insuffisamment maîtrisés

  • un potentiel d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA encore peu exploité

Certaines briques sont déjà portées en interne, mais de manière partielle ou trop manuelle.

Nous créons ce poste pour structurer durablement le SI, fiabiliser les flux et accompagner la montée en maturité de l’organisation.

Ton rôle

Rattaché au CTO, tu interviens de manière transverse sur l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

Le poste est volontairement hybride : à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. L’objectif n’est pas uniquement de piloter, mais de comprendre, structurer et mettre en œuvre.

Tu travailles en lien étroit avec le CODIR et les équipes métiers.

Tes responsabilités

Structuration du SI et des flux

  • Cartographier les outils et les flux existants

  • Identifier les points de friction et les incohérences

  • Structurer la circulation de la donnée (clients, prospects, finance…)

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les intégrations entre les systèmes

L’objectif est d’éliminer les silos et de fiabiliser les échanges de données.

Reprise en main des sujets critiques

  • Monter en compétence sur les outils clés, notamment la facturation

  • Fiabiliser les processus existants

  • Réduire la dépendance aux tâches manuelles via l’automatisation

Pilotage de l’écosystème outils

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers

  • Définir une logique cohérente d’évolution du SI

  • Arbitrer entre amélioration de l’existant et mise en place de nouveaux outils

  • Piloter les projets SI de bout en bout

Management d’équipe

  • Encadrer une équipe de 3 développeurs

  • Prioriser les sujets en fonction des enjeux business

  • Structurer le backlog et assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise

Développement des usages IA

  • Identifier des cas d’usage concrets avec les équipes

  • Prototyper et déployer des solutions

  • Accompagner l’adoption


Ce que tu apportes

  • 6 à 10 ans d’expérience en SI applicatif, Business Systems ou équivalent

  • Une expérience en environnement SaaS (idéalement dans des structures de 200 à 500 personnes)

  • Une bonne maîtrise des problématiques d’intégration et de flux de données (API, webhooks, synchronisation)

  • Une capacité à comprendre, challenger et structurer un écosystème d’outils dans sa globalité

  • Une expérience avec des outils d’automatisation (Make, Zapier, n8n ou équivalent)

  • Une expérience en management d’équipe technique

  • Une capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés

Ce poste n’est pas adapté si

  • tu es très orienté(e) grands groupes avec des SI lourds et peu agiles

  • tu recherches un rôle purement stratégique sans implication opérationnelle

  • ton expertise est principalement orientée sécurité (ce périmètre est couvert par un autre rôle)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Une entreprise SaaS solide avec des fondamentaux rares, qui combine croissance soutenue et rentabilité

  • Tu arrives à un moment clé où beaucoup reste à structurer pour passer un cap, avec déjà une base existante

  • Une proximité avec la direction, un bon niveau d’autonomie et des cycles de décision rapides

  • Un rôle avec un impact visible rapidement, aussi bien sur les équipes que sur les résultats

  • Des sujets variés et concrets, entre structuration du SI et montée en gamme

  • Une équipe accessible, impliquée et orientée résultats

Poste basé à Montagnat (01) avec présence attendue 2 jours par semaine.

Senior Revenue Operations Analyst

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Instructure is looking for a high-performing Revenue Operations Analyst to support our global Sales Operations function. Reporting to the Director of Planning and Analytics, this role partners across Business Units to deliver data-driven insights on bookings, pipeline health, and sales performance. You'll build the reporting and analysis that helps leadership make faster, better-informed decisions. You'll also support the Revenue Operations team on Annual Planning activities.

You'll work closely with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations teams to turn raw data into clear recommendations. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and analytical skills with the judgment to know what a number actually means for the business.

This position can be worked remotely.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain SQL queries and reports that track bookings, pipeline coverage, and conversion, and monitor CRM data quality to resolve issues at the source.

  • Analyze pipeline trends and support the weekly forecasting review cadence with clean, accurate data that flags risk before it becomes a forecast miss.

  • Partner with regional and global Sales Operations teams to keep metric definitions and reporting standards consistent.

  • Build standardized templates for territory planning, account segmentation, and quota allocation, and partner with field Sales Operations business partners to deliver them on schedule during the H2 Annual Planning cycle.

  • Build sales rep capacity models to inform headcount and territory coverage decisions.

  • Translate ad hoc business questions into structured analysis and clear, leadership-ready answers.

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and reduce manual work, using AI tools where applicable.

  • Contribute to global Sales Operations projects and share practices that scale across regions.

What You'll Need

  • Two or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or a related go-to-market analytical role, preferably within a SaaS or recurring-revenue business.

  • AI fluency, with experience using AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience querying and reporting on data in Salesforce, plus experience building or scoping dashboards in Tableau or a comparable business-intelligence platform.

  • A strong understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting metrics.

  • Sound business judgment — the ability to turn complex data into clear insights and question assumptions rather than accept them at face value.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both frontline teams and senior leadership.

  • High attention to detail and a proactive, adaptable approach suited to a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field, or equivalent job experience.

  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform.

  • Experience with revenue technology platforms, such as Clari and Gong.

  • Experience supporting bookings, pipeline, or forecast analysis across multiple regions or business units.

  • Comfort working across time zones with global stakeholders.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

    • Was wir Dir bieten:

     • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
     • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg.
    • Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen.

     • Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards.

    Über Caseware:
    Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind. Du hast richtig Lust, Social-Media-Accounts eigenständig zu übernehmen und wachsen zu lassen? Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, drehst Reels, hast Ideen im Kopf, bevor jemand danach fragt, und begeisterst dich für KI- und Digitalthemen? Dann suchen wir genau dich: Als Werkstudentin (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die Social-Media-Betreuung von zwei Marken, Mainwebsolutions und Closery, und baust gemeinsam mit den Gründern ein eigenes Podcast-Format auf. Bewirb dich jetzt auf eine Werkstudierendenstelle mit echter Verantwortung.

Was erwartet dich bei uns?

Willkommen bei Mainwebsolutions, der Agentur, die Softwareentwicklung und Onlinemarketing auf ein neues Level hebt! Unser Team besteht aus talentierten Marketern und Entwicklern, die gemeinsam durchstarten. Mit Closery, unserer Voice-AI-Plattform für Shopify und E-Commerce, bauen wir zudem ein eigenes SaaS-Produkt auf, das du auf Social Media von Tag eins an mitprägst. Jeder Tag beginnt mit einer ordentlichen Portion Humor und einem morgendlichen Meeting, in dem wir einander über aktuelle Themen und Fortschritte informieren. Anschließend tauchen wir in die Projekte ein und arbeiten gemeinsam daran, den Erfolg unserer Kunden und unserer eigenen Produkte weiter zu steigern. Doch bei uns geht es nicht nur um Arbeit! Wir feiern unsere Erfolge regelmäßig mit coolen Teamevents. Von Grillpartys auf der Dachterrasse bis zu geselligen Weinfesten, jeder kann sich an unseren Aktivitäten beteiligen. Eines ist sicher: Bei uns steht das Team an erster Stelle. Erlebe den Spirit von Mainwebsolutions! #workatmws

Dein Aufgabenbereich?

Du übernimmst die Social-Media-Accounts von Mainwebsolutions und Closery autark, also von der Idee über die Umsetzung bis zur Analyse. Du entwickelst eigenständig Content-Ideen und Formate, planst deine Beiträge selbst und sorgst dafür, dass beide Accounts auf Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok und Co. sichtbar wachsen. Dabei stehst du selbst vor der Kamera: Du drehst Reels, sprichst in kurzen Videos über KI-, Digital- und E-Commerce-Themen und gibst unseren Marken ein Gesicht. Gemeinsam mit den Geschäftsführern beider Brands baust du ein kleines Podcast-Format auf, begleitest die Aufnahmen, schneidest die Folgen und verwertest sie als Clips für Social Media. Du beobachtest Trends, testest neue Formate und leitest aus den Zahlen ab, was funktioniert und was nicht. Vorgaben brauchst du dafür keine, du bringst die Ideen mit und setzt sie um.



Das bringst du mit:

  • Lust auf eigene Accounts: Du willst nicht nur zuarbeiten, sondern Social-Media-Kanäle eigenverantwortlich führen und sichtbar wachsen lassen.

  • Keine Kamerascheu: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, drehst Reels, sprichst frei in Videos und hast Lust, in einem Podcast-Format mit unseren Geschäftsführern mitzuwirken.

  • Begeisterung für KI- und Digitalthemen: Künstliche Intelligenz, Automatisierung, E-Commerce und Onlinemarketing interessieren dich wirklich, und du kannst diese Themen verständlich und unterhaltsam erzählen.

  • Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative: Du generierst eigene Ideen, planst deinen Content selbst und brauchst keine Vorgaben, um loszulegen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Social-Media-Plattformen: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn und Co. sind dir vertraut, und du verstehst, welche Inhalte dort funktionieren.

  • Grundkenntnisse im Videoschnitt: Du musst kein Video-Profi sein, aber du kannst ein Reel oder eine Podcast-Folge mit Tools wie CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbarer Software schneiden oder hast Lust, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Trendgespür und Teamgeist: Du erkennst Trends früh, bist offen für Feedback und hast Spaß daran, in einem dynamischen Team etwas aufzubauen.


Das bieten wir:

  • Sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Unser Ziel ist es, jede Person, die wir einstellen, individuell zu fördern und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten, damit du gemeinsam mit uns wachsen kannst.

  • Team Family: Flache Hierarchien, eine offene Feedbackkultur und regelmäßige gemeinsame Teamevents, die du nicht verpassen solltest. Wenn du Full-Remote für uns arbeitest und an einem Teamevent teilnehmen möchtest, übernehmen wir selbstverständlich Transfer- und Hotelkosten für dich.

Neben der Möglichkeit der Absolvierung verschiedener Zertifizierungen nehmen wir sowohl an Online- als auch an Offline-Events mit unserem Team teil. Hierfür steht dir jährlich 1.500€ Weiterentwicklungsbudget zur Verfügung.

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Bei Almedia wirst du:

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du übernimmst früh wichtige Creator Partnerships und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir wachsen.

Gehaltsspanne: 55.000 bis 65.000 € pro Jahr

Was du machst 🎯

Du verantwortest bei Almedia den gesamten Creator-Partnership-Prozess. Vom Finden der richtigen Creator über den Deal bis zur erfolgreichen Kampagnen-Performance.

  • Creator Sourcing: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Creator auf Instagram und YouTube, sprichst sie gezielt an und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.

  • Campaign Management: Du steuerst Kampagnen von Anfang bis Ende und stellst sicher, dass der Content pünktlich, hochwertig und markenkonform live geht.

  • Performance: Du analysierst die Ergebnisse, erkennst Potenziale und entwickelst erfolgreiche Creator Partnerships kontinuierlich weiter.

Dein Alltag 💡

  • Du entdeckst Creator-Potenzial: Du recherchierst proaktiv und identifizierst Creators, die perfekt zu unserer Brand und unseren Zielen passen.

  • Du baust echte Partnerschaften auf: Von der ersten Ansprache bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit entwickelst du starke Beziehungen zu Creators.

  • Du steuerst Kampagnen end-to-end: Vom Briefing über die Content-Abstimmung bis zum Go-live und der anschließenden Auswertung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir.

  • Du denkst performanceorientiert: Du trackst KPIs wie CPM, CPI und ROAS, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt Learnings schnell um.

  • Du skalierst unser Creator-Netzwerk: Du pflegst unsere Creator-Datenbank, entwickelst sie weiter und schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum.

  • Du arbeitest crossfunktional: Gemeinsam mit Performance Marketing und Creative entwickelst du Kampagnen, die kreativ überzeugen und messbare Ergebnisse liefern.

Was du mitbringst 🌟

  • Du bringst relevante Erfahrung mit: Idealerweise hast du bereits 1 bis 4 Jahre im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld gearbeitet.

  • Du verstehst die Plattformen: Instagram und YouTube kennst du nicht nur als User. Du verstehst Formate, Trends und weißt, welcher Content wirklich konvertiert.

  • Du kannst verhandeln: Du hast bereits Deals mit Creators oder Managements verhandelt und weißt, wie man starke Partnerschaften aufsetzt.

  • Du denkst datengetrieben: Zahlen helfen dir, Chancen zu erkennen, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Kampagnen gezielt zu optimieren.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher: Dein Deutsch ist fließend in Wort und Schrift, dein Englisch sehr gut.

  • Du hast echten Ownership-Mindset: Du wartest nicht auf den nächsten Auftrag, sondern erkennst selbst, was getan werden muss, und setzt es um.

Nice to have:

  • Du kennst die richtigen Tools: Mit Plattformen wie Upfluence, Modash oder vergleichbaren Creator-Marketing-Tools hast du bereits gearbeitet.

  • Du verstehst Performance: Erfahrung im Performance Marketing oder in der Mobile User Acquisition ist ein starkes Plus.

  • Du bringst ein Netzwerk mit: Du hast bereits gute Kontakte zu Creators, Agenturen oder Managements und kannst darauf aufbauen.

Warum Almedia? 🎁

  • Dein Erfolg ist unser Erfolg: Alle Mitarbeitenden in Berlin erhalten Unternehmensanteile und profitieren damit direkt von unserer gemeinsamen Entwicklung.

  • Wachse mit uns: Werde Teil eines seit Tag eins profitablen Startups und entwickle dich in einem Umfeld weiter, das ambitioniert denkt und schnell wächst.

  • Ein Office, in dem etwas passiert: Unser modernes, voll ausgestattetes Büro liegt mitten in Berlin, ist bestens erreichbar und auf echten Austausch ausgelegt.

  • Benefits, die deinen Alltag besser machen: Freu dich unter anderem auf einen Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Frühstück und Mittagessen, Sprachkurse sowie eine Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

IT Manager

About the role

We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving practical problems and making everyday IT work well, reporting into the CIO and based in London.

A big part of the job is security in a practical, operational sense. You'll keep devices patched and well configured, control who has access to what, bring order to the software and accounts that build up as a company grows, and make joining and leaving smooth and secure. You'll operate the controls and standards that the security team sets, and you'll be the person who makes them real in day-to-day work.

You'll work across the whole company, so you'll need to balance keeping people productive with keeping them secure, and be comfortable being the go-to person for anything IT.

Job responsibilities

  • Own endpoint security in practice, including device configuration, patching, controlling local admin rights, and reducing unmanaged software

  • Look after workplace and network security, including the office network and keeping guest and corporate access properly separated

  • Run identity operations day to day, including provisioning, joiner, mover and leaver changes, and regular access reviews

  • Manage software and licensing across the company, and bring order to tools that have crept in without oversight

  • Manage 3rd party vendors such as internet suppliers

  • Look after the office network, devices and everyday hardware

  • Run the IT helpdesk and make sure people get quick, helpful support

  • Make joining and leaving the company a smooth, well-run experience

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Experience managing IT operations in a growing company

  • Hands-on with device management and endpoint tooling

  • Comfortable with identity and access operations, including provisioning and access reviews

jobs.title: Senior GTM Manager
jobs.description:
Senior GTM Manager

📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a Senior GTM Manager to join the Buy Engine.

tem predominantly sells through a partner network to SME businesses, and this role owns partner activation from systems to story. You’ll build the automation layer that makes the programme scalable, run the events and community engine that builds trust in market, drive the ABM plays that generate targeted pipeline, and translate tem’s product complexity into narratives partners and buy-side clients actually use. The metric you move is new pipeline generated.

The job requires two gears running in parallel. You ship fast, drawing on experience rather than waiting for a brief. And you zoom out regularly to build the systems that mean the next quarter is easier than this one.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Ship the agentic workflows that take the manual drag out of events, partner comms, and product marketing.

  • Build our events programme into a system that enables more in-person and community engagement across the UK and abroad.

  • Run ABM plays that generate new pipeline, with clear leading metrics helping you iterate quickly.

  • Turn tem’s most complex product and pricing innovation into positioning partners can sell.

  • Develop the automated product launch workflow, from PM spec through to go-to-market brief.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Build and automate: design and ship the agentic workflows that remove manual drag from events, partner comms, and product marketing, and keep building the GTM automation stack as the programme grows.

  • Run partner activation: own the events programme end to end, drive stickiness and engagement on our core activation channels, and run GTM experiments inside tem’s fortnightly sprint rhythm, compounding the playbook sprint by sprint.

  • Translate complexity into narrative: turn the hardest parts of energy into positioning partners can sell and customers are persuaded by, and keep the market story consistent and specific.

  • Own the intelligence loop: turn customer insights into structured signals that actively challenge and improve our positioning and GTM priorities, and own competitive intelligence on our key GTM bets.

  • Measure what matters: track what each activation play costs in time and money and what it returns in pipeline, own the reporting inside the fortnightly rhythm, and build the institutional memory that means the engine doesn’t reset when people join or leave.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Builder orientation: you ship fast, draw on experience, and don’t need a fully formed brief to move.

  • Systems thinking in parallel: you can zoom out from daily execution to build the infrastructure that scales the programme, and do both at once.

  • Marketing literacy across the full GTM stack: positioning, narrative, activation, and channel strategy.

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI or no-code tools, with evidence you’ve built real workflows rather than one-off experiments.

  • B2B or B2B2C channel experience: you’ve marketed through or to a partner network, not just direct.

  • Comfortable operating at pace in a Series B environment where the playbook is being written as you go and the standards matter.

Desirable

  • Experience owning or contributing to an ABM programme.

  • Community or events programme ownership.

  • Exposure to complex or regulated industries where product narrative is genuinely hard, such as energy, fintech, infrastructure, or healthcare.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss your approach to GTM systems design and partner activation.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

You’ll also be Finance’s counterpart to the data team. You won’t be a data engineer, and you won’t be responsible for building data pipelines or owning the warehouse - but you will need a working knowledge of SQL. You’ll use it continuously to answer Finance’s questions, make reporting trustworthy, and make sure the dashboards and definitions we rely on are accurate.

  • Align data definitions with finance reports and get to the bottom of open questions like P442 revenue.

  • Run ad hoc analysis for the CFO, Head of FP&A, Financial Controller and wider Finance team.

  • Deploy single-purpose agents to make repeatable analysis faster and more accurate.

  • Sharp analytical instincts - we’ll take a greener person who’s brilliant over years of tenure.

Desirable

  • Exposure to energy, fintech, or trading businesses.

  • Experience with BI or dashboard tools.

  • Experience working directly alongside a data team.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss a practical analysis exercise - digging into a dataset and framing what it means for finance.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1100+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
Senior Account Manager 🇫🇷

E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that.

We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.

Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 9 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.

Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion.

The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.

 

About The Role 🚀

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for retaining and growing Bigblue’s key accounts — some of the most promising European D2C brands — and play a central role in their success.

Location: Paris 9th, France (Hybrid)

As an Account Manager, you will:

  • Build strong, long-term partnerships
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic merchant accounts
  • Act as a trusted advisor by connecting operational topics (service, cost, performance) to business impact
  • Define improvement plans with merchants based on data analysis
  • Identify new partnership opportunities and define improvement plans with merchants
  • Deliver customer excellence
  • Support stakeholders in their day-to-day use of Bigblue’s services
  • Monitor customer feedback and performance trends, and translate them into actionable improvements
  • Contribute to product and operational improvements based on merchant insights and market trends
  • Optimize internal processes and tools to improve the overall customer experience
  • Grow hand-in-hand
  • Contribute to our merchants’ strategic development and identify their metrics that drive growth
  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them
  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing merchants
  • Lead cross-selling and upselling efforts to address customer needs and unlock value

    • You would be a great fit if this sounds like you:
  • You have +5 years of experience in a customer-facing role with regular stakeholder interactions
  • You have a native level of French and professional working proficiency in English
  • You have a growth mindset and are eager to build a strong understanding of the logistics market
  • You are comfortable analyzing data and presenting insights during business reviews
  • You have solid Excel skills
  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris

    • And you also:

  • Have strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Are analytical and able to leverage data to drive decisions
  • Can solve complex problems and prioritize effectively
  • Demonstrate business acumen and strategic thinking (growing with experience)
  • Are comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously
  • Are proactive, autonomous, and adaptable

    • Bonus points for 🥇
  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit
  • You're passionate about digital and making life simpler with technology
  • You like solving new problems and are never settling for how something "has always been done"
  • You speak another language (Spanish, German
