jobs.title: Head of AI Enablement
jobs.description:
Head of AI Enablement
📍 Paris | Full-time | Fluent 🇫🇷 & 🇬🇧
 

At Bigblue, we're building the logistics backbone for the next generation of commerce.

Modern brands sell everywhere: through their own online stores, marketplaces, retail, social commerce, and more. Across every channel, customers expect the same fast, reliable, and transparent experience after they buy. What used to be Amazon's exclusive advantage is now becoming the standard for every ambitious brand. We're helping them get there.

Since 2018, we've built a tech-driven fulfilment platform used by 600+ brands, including Muji, Aigle, Scuffers, and Cabaïa. With 200+ Bigbluers across the UK, France, Spain, and Germany, our proprietary tech stack, and a network of 9 warehouses and over 100,000 sqm of fulfilment space across Europe, we ship millions of orders every month. And we're nowhere near done!

Backed by €20M+ in funding, we're expanding across Europe and building the operating system that will power modern commerce operations at a global scale.

At Bigblue, we hold ourselves to a very high bar: in the quality of our product, the rigour of our operations, and the care we bring to every merchant we work with. You'll be working alongside talented people on real, high-impact problems, in an environment where high standards come with genuine support, ownership, and room to grow. If you want your work to matter from day one, you're in the right place.

 
 

About the Role

As Head of AI Enablement, you will help Bigblue become the most productive commerce operations company in Europe through AI. Your job is not just to raise AI usage across the business — it is to instill an AI-first mindset, so that every team develops a muscle for reaching for new AI capabilities instinctively, and is enabled to act on those instincts.

This role sits at the intersection of internal transformation and external impact. The AI systems and workflows you build internally are increasingly becoming part of Bigblue's external story — shaping how we serve merchants, how our agents engage with them in-product, and how we turn our own operational learnings into time and money saved for the 600+ brands we serve.

You will work across disciplines as part builder, part data expert, part product manager, and part business-ops maven, co-developing the cutting edge of AI tooling for the Bigblue team and using it to drive massive change at high velocity. You will start hands-on, shipping the first high-impact automations yourself, then scale a team of AI engineers to multiply your impact across every function.


What you'll do
  • Make sure Bigblue teams can deploy AI tools and workflows at the fastest rate in the industry — through enablement and through the development of internal AI products, agents, skills, and tools.
  • Get non-engineering teams (Account management, Sales, Finance, Transportation, Logistics) leveraging our internal AI stack through focused enablement, product improvements, and individual success stories — surfacing context from our stack, automating merchant-issue triage, billing exceptions, and reporting.
  • Measure the impact of internal products via (AI-built!) dashboards and QA checks, and iterate based on real user feedback.
  • Seed an AI-native culture: coach internal "AI champions" and embed templates and practices into team norms.
  • Build feedback loops that make internal agent performance compound over time — making teams faster and higher-quality at their work, while evolving the external-facing systems that sharpen how Bigblue engages with merchants through AI.
  • Tackle foundational AI infrastructure with our technical teams: data reliability, managing shared AI skills at scale, and the hard operational problems underneath a truly AI-powered company.
  • Help package and tell Bigblue's internal AI journey externally — through merchant pitches, conferences, and content — as we productize what we've built for our customers.

    • What You Need
  • 4-8+ years in product management, product ops, BizOps, strategy, technical program management, engineering, or similar — with deep, demonstrated experience using AI to build, ship, and transform work.
  • Technical fluency with development copilots and low-code/no-code tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Notion), SQL and BI tools, APIs, scripting, and integrations.
  • LLM integration depth: tool use, structured outputs, prompt engineering, fallback handling, and cost controls with OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent.
  • Operational empathy: you partner with business teams to deeply understand their challenges and ship rapid solutions.
  • Strong communicator: you write crisp docs (with AI!) and run persuasive internal training sessions that have lasting impact.
  • Comfort being steeped in operational and usage data — you decide based on what's actually happening, not just what teams report.
  • Self-starter with high agency, comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity. Production discipline: fast iteration without fragile systems.

    • Nice-to-Haves
  • Familiarity with departmental workflows in operating teams.
  • Prior experience in internal enablement or change-management programs.
  • Curiosity about external applications of internal AI work: customer-facing agents, or commercializing operational learnings.
  • Familiarity with logistics, supply chain, or operations-heavy B2B environments.
  • French language skills (our team operates across France, Spain, the UK, and Germany).

    • Not for You if
  • You prefer strategy briefings over hands-on delivery.
  • You lean toward AI research rather than applied AI work.
  • You'd rather manage people than building solutions and finding new edges through technology.
  • You're not interested in the sometimes unglamorous work of making AI systems reliable and scalable.

    • What success looks like

    In your first 30 days, you have embedded with at least one internal team, mapped a workflow end-to-end, and shipped something real into production.

    By 90 days, you have measurably reduced manual work that was previously just accepted as the cost of doing business, and people in that team can point to it.

    By six months, internal teams are coming to you with problems before they even think to file a ticket; you have a library of reusable patterns that others are building on, and you and the team you have hired set the standard for how AI-powered internal tooling gets built at Bigblue.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - DACH
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative - DACH

Standort: Remote in Deutschland oder flexibles Büro in Berlin

Wir bei HubSpot laden alle, unabhängig vom Abschluss, ein, sich unserem Vertriebsteam als Business Development Representative (kurz BDR) anzuschließen. Unser Ziel ist es, eine vielfältige und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen, die Talente verschiedener Generationen schätzt und fördert. Ob du gerade deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast oder deine Karriere im SaaS-Vertrieb beschleunigen möchtest, wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Gemäß Modells für die Zukunft der Arbeit bieten wir sowohl Büro- als auch Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten innerhalb Deutschlands an.

Die Aufgabe eines Business Development Representative besteht darin, durch strategische Kundengewinnung geeignete Unternehmen zu identifizieren und mit diesen zu interagieren. Dies geschieht unter Verwendung bereits existierender HubSpot-Leads, deren Interesse durch Anrufe, E-Mails sowie Messaging über soziale Medien erneut geweckt wird.

Im Rahmen deiner Kontaktaufnahme mit potenzieller Kundschaft erfährst du als BDR mehr darüber, mit welchen Herausforderungen sich das jeweilige Unternehmen konfrontiert sieht, und können so entscheiden, ob HubSpot hier als Lösung herangezogen werden kann. Wenn du einen qualifizierten Interessenten oder eine qualifizierte Interessentin identifiziert hast, besteht Ihr Ziel darin, den Wert von HubSpot prägnant und präzise zu kommunizieren und Interesse an einem tiefer gehenden Gespräch mit einem Account Executive zu wecken.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die enge Zusammenarbeit mit 2 bis 3 Account Executives. Du wirst täglich mit den von dir unterstützten Account Executives sowie mit anderen BDRs zusammenarbeiten, um innovative Strategien zur Ermittlung neuer Opportunität zu entwickeln. BDRs, die sich erfolgreich in ihrer Rolle behaupten, werden anschließend zu Account Executives innerhalb unseres Vertriebsteams.

Was fällt in den Verantwortungsbereich eines Business Development Representative?

Folgende Aufgaben und Verantwortungen erwarten dich in dieser Vollzeitsbeschäftigung:

  • Ein hoher Umfang an Outbound-Aktivitäten zur Akquise und Qualifizierung von Leads (neue Kunden)
  • Eng mit Account Executives zusammenarbeiten, um Strategien und Pläne für die Kundengewinnung zu entwickeln und zu implementieren
  • Planen von Online-Produktdemonstrationen für qualifizierte Leads bei gleichzeitigem Sicherstellen, dass deine monatlichen Ziele erreicht werden
  • Verstehen der Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen von Kunden und Kundinnen unter Einsatz bestimmter Verkaufsmethoden wie der BANT-Methodik
  • Durchführen von Marktforschung, um den Kundenstamm von HubSpot zu erweitern

Welche Voraussetzungen gibt es für diese Stelle?

  • Engagement und Begeisterung für die Technologiebranche und den Vertrieb
  • Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Vertrieb oder Kundengewinnung und in einer wachstumsstarken „Scale-up“-Umgebung ist nicht erforderlich, aber von Vorteil
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Scharfer, zielorientierter Fokus und ein überzeugender, stringenter Ansatz bei der Zielumsetzung
  • Die Fähigkeit, mit Einwänden umzugehen und auf diese einzugehen, sowie die Bereitschaft, sich coachen zu lassen
  • Starke Organisationsfähigkeit und sehr gutes Zeitmanagement
  • Leidenschaft dafür, Unternehmen bei ihrem Wachstum zu unterstützen, und Interesse für die Technologiebranche

Was hast du davon?

  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das persönliche Arbeitspräferenzen berücksichtigt
  • Tolle Teammitglieder in einem kulturell vielfältigen Arbeitsumfeld sowie Unterstützung durch eine Mentorin oder einen Mentor
  • Interaktives Mitarbeitertraining und ein einmonatiges Onboarding, um dir den Einstieg zu erleichtern
  • Ein klar abgesteckter Karriereweg mit regelmäßigen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten
  • Erstattung von Studiengebühren in Höhe von maximal 4.250 Euro im Jahr und ein kostenloses Bücherprogramm, um die persönliche Weiterbildung zu fördern
  • Coaching- und Therapiesitzungen über die Modern Health-App zur Förderung des mentalen Wohlbefindens sowie andere Gesundheitsleistungen, z. B. Lebensversicherung, Absicherungen im Falle längerer Krankheit oder Erstattung von Fitnessstudiogebühren in Höhe von bis zu 250 Euro

Please note: This is a role that we hire on an ongoing basis throughout the year. If you choose to apply for this role, your information will be reviewed by our recruiting team and we will reach out to you if your background matches an opening at this time or in the future.

Account Executive, Small Business - Central & East Europe

As an Account Executive at HubSpot, you use selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You benefit from inbound leads and research prospects to create outreach strategies. You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small-sized businesses.

We are actively hiring for a Small Business Account Executive; candidates have the choice to be office, flex or remotely located in Germany and Ireland, based on individual preference! What are the responsibilities of an Account Executive?

  • Consistently close new business at or above quota level
  • Build relationships with prospects and internal stakeholders to grow new business
  • Work collaboratively with HubSpot's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced

Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

Konkret:

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.
  • ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie.
  • BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer.
  • SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann.


Dein Talent

  • SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen

  • WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement

  • AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal.

  • AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht.

  • ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke.

  • DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen.

  • DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende.

  • MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen.


Unser Angebot

Wachstum & Kultur

Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg.

Impact & Awareness

Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen.

Flexibilität & Vertrauen

Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team.

Extra Benefits für dich

Wir machen deinen Alltag einfacher: Du bekommst einen flexiblen Bonus, den du nach Lust und Laune für Dinge einsetzen kannst, die dir Freude machen – ob Fitness, Kultur oder kleine Extras.

Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden

Wenn der Arbeitstag mal länger wird, sorgen wir dafür, dass niemand hungrig bleibt. Bestell dir über Wolt eine Mahlzeit direkt ins Büro – easy und lecker.

Community & Spirit

Wir verändern die Welt – und verlieren dabei nie den Spaß. Freu dich auf regelmäßige Offsites, Teamabende und unser legendäres „Bees & Beers“ als perfekten Ausgleich zu unserer Mission.

Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
jobs.description:
Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content

About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar

jobs.description:
Head of People Partnering & Development

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Accompagne la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble les HRBPs et le People Development

Pennylane est une scale-up fintech de 1 200 collaborateurs, présente en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Dans un contexte de forte croissance, d’expansion européenne et de transformation des métiers par l’IA, nous recrutons notre futur·e Head of People Partnering & Development.

Rattaché·e à la VP People, tu travailleras au plus près du COMEX et des leaders de l’entreprise.

Ta mission

Ta mission sera d’accompagner la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble deux disciplines complémentaires :

  • les HRBPs, qui accompagnent les équipes, les managers et les organisations au plus près des enjeux business ;

  • le People Development, qui porte le développement des compétences, la performance, les career paths, la gestion des talents et les programmes managers.

Tu veilleras à connecter ces expertises afin de proposer une approche People cohérente, internationale et directement alignée avec les priorités business.

Tes principales responsabilités

Stratégie People et accompagnement du business

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap commune HRBP et People Development ;

  • accompagner les enjeux organisationnels liés à la croissance et à l’internationalisation ;

  • conseiller et challenger les leaders sur leurs enjeux d’organisation, de management et de talents ;

  • développer une approche People fondée sur la donnée et l’anticipation ;

  • suivre les indicateurs clés : turnover, engagement, performance, capacité organisationnelle et développement des compétences.

Coordination internationale

  • Garantir une approche cohérente entre la France, l’Allemagne et l’Espagne ;

  • coordonner les sujets cross-country : mobilité, career paths, performance et pratiques managériales ;

  • trouver le bon équilibre entre harmonisation internationale et spécificités locales ;

  • contribuer à la construction d’une culture commune.

Management et collaboration des équipes

  • Manager et développer une équipe d’environ 11 personnes sur les pôles HRBP et People Development ;

  • créer les conditions d’une collaboration efficace entre les deux disciplines ;

  • clarifier les rôles, les responsabilités et les modes de fonctionnement ;

  • renforcer la posture stratégique et l’influence de l’équipe auprès des leaders ;

  • développer les compétences de l’équipe sur la data, le change et l’IA.

Talents, performance et développement

  • Piloter la stratégie Learning & Development ;

  • structurer les cycles de performance et les calibrations ;

  • développer les career paths, le job grading et le levelling ;

  • piloter les talent reviews et le succession planning ;

  • développer les programmes managers ;

  • accompagner les initiatives liées à l’engagement, à la culture et à la reconnaissance.

IA et transformation des métiers

  • Anticiper l’impact de l’IA sur les métiers, les compétences et les organisations ;

  • identifier les cas d’usage pertinents pour la fonction People ;

  • accompagner les équipes et les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ;

  • intégrer l’IA dans les pratiques HRBP et People Development de manière utile et responsable.

Le profil recherché

Tu as 8 à 12 ans d’expérience en RH, dont au moins 3 à 4 ans dans un rôle de leadership, par exemple :

  • DRH ou Head of People dans une entreprise tech de 200 à 600 collaborateurs ;

  • Head of HRBP dans une scale-up ou une entreprise en forte croissance ;

  • Head of HRBP dans un grand groupe

Tu as déjà structuré une fonction RH ou HRBP, recruté et développé une équipe, travaillé avec des dirigeants et accompagné une organisation en croissance. Une expérience internationale et une première pratique de l’IA dans un contexte RH seront particulièrement appréciées.

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu combines :

  • une forte compréhension des enjeux business et organisationnels ;

  • une capacité à influencer et challenger les leaders ;

  • un vrai talent pour faire travailler ensemble des expertises différentes ;

  • une approche structurée, data-driven et orientée résultats ;

  • de la curiosité pour l’IA et les nouvelles technologies ;

  • du courage managérial, de l’humilité et le goût du collectif.

Les dimensions du poste

  • Périmètre : 1 100 collaborateurs ;

  • Pays : France, Allemagne et Espagne ;

  • Équipe : environ 11 personnes ;

  • Rattachement : VP People ;

  • Interlocuteurs clés : COMEX, Directors, Heads of, Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Legal et Compensation.

Processus de recrutement

- 1ère échange avec Nathalie, Talent Acquisition - 45min

- Entretien avec Marine, VP people (1 h)

- Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Marine et Felix, Co-fondateur (1 h)

- Dernier entretien avec les leads People (TA et People Ops) + échange avec les HRBP (30-45 min)

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

 

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

Que faisons-nous pour faciliter votre vie professionnelle ?

Business Intelligence Engineer Intern — Ops Excellence

💙 About Bigblue

E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we're on a mission to change that. We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.

Since 2018, we've built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 7 warehouses across Europe, we're solving logistics challenges that others haven't dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.

Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we're scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we're looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.

📊 What data means for Bigblue

At Bigblue, data is the backbone of how we operate. Our data infrastructure — built on BigQuery and dbt, surfaced through Metabase — powers every operational decision: from tracking fulfillment performance across 7 warehouses to monitoring carrier service rates in real time. As we scale across Europe, our BI layer needs to scale with us.

The Ops Excellence team is at the heart of this challenge: translating raw warehouse and transportation data into reliable, structured, and accessible intelligence — so our operators, product teams, and executives can act fast and act right.


🚀 The role

Location: Paris — 7 rue Caumartin, 75009

Type: End-of-studies internship or gap year (SFE / césure)

Duration: 6 months

Start: ASAP

Bigblue is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer Intern to join the Ops Excellence team.

This is a highly technical role at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You won't just consume data — you'll help build the infrastructure that makes it accessible, reliable, and actionable for our entire Ops organization. This is a unique opportunity to work on real-scale, production-grade BI systems in a fast-moving logistics startup.


✍️ Our data challenges
  • Data pipeline development: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that consolidate and transform raw warehouse and operational data into clean, structured datasets ready for analysis — using SQL, dbt, and our BigQuery data warehouse.
  • Dashboard & reporting infrastructure: Develop scalable BI solutions — datasets, reports, and Metabase dashboards — that give our Ops teams real-time visibility into fulfillment KPIs, warehouse performance, and service levels.
  • Data modeling & schema design: Create and manage data structures that are robust, well-documented, and easy for analysts across teams to use — applying best practices in schema design and data governance.
  • Automation & process improvement: Write secure, maintainable code that automates recurring reporting tasks and frees our analysts to focus on higher-value work. Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with scalable, engineered solutions.
  • Data quality & reliability: Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues, propose solutions, and take ownership of resolutions — ensuring that the numbers our teams rely on are always accurate and up to date.

    • 🙌 Your profile
  • Student in year 4 or 5 of an engineering school, computer science, statistics, or equivalent program
  • Strong SQL skills — able to write complex queries, optimize for performance, and model data from scratch
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools and concepts: dbt, BigQuery, ETL pipelines, data modeling
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, or similar)
  • Python or another scripting language is a strong plus
  • You think in terms of systems: you care about code quality, reusability, and long-term maintainability
  • Curious and rigorous — you go deep to understand the data before trusting it
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup environment with evolving requirements
  • Fluency in English and French

    • 🎁 What we offer

Head of Marketing & Lead Generation

Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?

Moka.Care has built strong foundations in a rapidly evolving market. We are now looking for a marketing leader who can scale our growth and pipeline generation efforts, strengthen our commercial execution, improve go-to-market effectiveness and continue building a leading brand for HR and People teams.

Reporting to Guillaume d’Ayguesvives, co-founder, you will own Moka.Care’s global marketing strategy with a strong focus on pipeline generation, revenue impact and commercial performance.

You’re the ideal person if

Joining us you will

Growth Marketing Corporate - France
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Chez Doctrine, on grandit vite. Très vite. De l'organique (nouveaux produits, nouveaux pays) comme de l'externe : 5 boîtes rachetées en 3 ans.
Résultat en 2026 : près de 30 000 clients dans 5 pays : France, Allemagne, Italie, Luxembourg et Espagne. Et sur notre marché historique, la France, on est loin d'avoir fini de jouer.

Doctrine est le leader européen de l'IA juridique. Mais un juriste d'entreprise ne travaille pas comme un avocat, et un dirigeant n'a pas les mêmes attentes qu'un juriste du secteur public.

Le segment Corporate (juristes privés et publics, experts et dirigeants d'entreprises) a ses propres codes, ses propres enjeux. C'est là que tu entres en scène : faire décoller la croissance de Doctrine sur le Corporate France.

Ton objectif n°1 : faire grimper l'ARR de Doctrine sur le segment Corporate en France. Un rôle stratégique, au cœur de la machine Go-to-Market, qui touche tout le funnel : acquisition, activation, rétention (upsell, cross-sell inclus).

L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu rejoins une équipe Growth de 4 personnes : ton futur manager, deux Growths sur les marchés internationaux et une personne sur le segment Avocat sur le marché français. En face, une vraie force de frappe commerciale que tu vas alimenter au quotidien : 10 BDR, 13 Account Executives et 6 Account Managers. Les leads que tu génères ont donc un terrain de jeu à la hauteur et ton impact se voit vite.

Le point de départ (plutôt sympa 👀)

  • Un modèle SaaS en forte croissance… et rentable (oui, les deux)
  • Un product market fit avec du momentum : près de 30 000 avocats et juristes déjà clients
  • Une équipe Go-to-Market (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) au top pour t'aider à dénicher de nouvelles poches de croissance
  • Une place de leader européen sur une des catégories les plus dynamique au monde : l'IA juridique
  • Une stack à la pointe et une bibliothèque de contenus déjà bien fournie pour dégainer sur les bons leviers et les objections de vente

Tes missions :

Au sein de l'équipe Growth, en collaboration avec les Sales Corporate et l’équipe marketing (PMM, Com, Event) tu passes tes journées à affûter le funnel sur le segment Corporate. Et surtout : tout est challengeable.

  • GTM Synch : animer les points réguliers avec l'équipe Sales Corporate pour définir avec eux, les priorités de campagnes en fonction des besoins terrain. Tu es le trait d'union entre le Growth et les Sales.
  • Outbound Lead Gen : dénicher les bons contacts pour les Sales et lancer les campagnes d'activation (enrichissement, automation, séquences, suivi des perfs).
  • Inbound Lead Gen : Aide au pilotage avec notre agence des campagnes sur Meta, LinkedIn et Google, pour générer un max de leads qualifiés.
  • Nurturing & customer education :
  • Bâtir et faire tourner les campagnes de nurturing sur des leads et contacts,
  • Épauler le Product Marketing sur les lancements produits et les campagnes d’usages à destination de nos utilisateurs,
  • Être le bras droit du marketing sur nos events, webinars et product launches.

    • Le profil qu'on recherche :

    Tu es la personne idéale si tu as envie d’avoir de l’impact, aimes avancer vite et tester de nouvelles approches aussi bien que maintenir des systèmes de campagnes en placer. Et évidemment, tu as à coeur de sortir un copywriting qui poussera à l’action.

    Pour le reste ? Pas besoin d'être un marketeur pur jus. Ops, RevOps, Tech, tous les chemins mènent au Growth. Ce qui compte vraiment : l'envie d'apprendre et de mettre les mains dans le cambouis pour faire grandir Doctrine.

    Hard skills

  • L'IA, c'est ton copilote : ce poste se travaille à 100 % avec l'IA. Production de campagnes, copywriting, analyse, automatisation. Un réflexe quotidien.
  • À l'aise (les mains dedans) sur les outils de marketing automation, sales engagement et CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…)
  • Tu comprends comment la data circule entre les outils pour créer, challenger et optimiser les parcours clients & prospects
  • Une vraie plume pour le copywriting et l'envie de comprendre ce qui fait vibrer notre cible (juristes, experts, dirigeants)
  • L'envie de construire des stratégies qui durent, pas juste du quick & dirty
  • Un peu d'analytique dans les veines (le SQL est un joli bonus)

    • Soft skills

  • Bon communicant, et tu sais faire parler la data pour trancher
  • Créatif·ve, curieux·se de la psychologie utilisateur pour imaginer des programmes qui marquent
  • Team player : tu navigues dans les équipes transverses et tu comprends les enjeux de chacun pour proposer les meilleurs plans d'action
  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience, idéalement dans un environnement tech.
  • Maitrise de l’anglais fortement recommandée car régulièrement utilisée en interne

    • Notre stack 🛠️
    Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

    Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)

Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Cloud Engineer (m/w/d)

Make impact. Be human. Stay curious.

Who we are

Founded in 2006, Rewire is an applied AI company helping organizations reinvent how they work with data and AI. We partner with leading organizations across industries to create scalable business impact by solving complex challenges through data, AI, and technology. Our team of 100+ data scientists, engineers, and change agents operates across Europe from offices in the Netherlands and Germany. Strategic in intent and pragmatic in execution, we combine deep Data & AI expertise with close, committed collaboration.

Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are at the heart of our culture. Through topic communities, expert colleagues, and our internal academy, GAIN, you'll have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills in areas such as Agentic AI, Data Strategy, AI Product Development, and Technology Platforms, while helping clients achieve measurable results.

Join a team that loves learning, solving challenges together, and having fun along the way. Ready to join the ride?

Where you’ll make a difference

  • Own and architect cloud foundations that power digital transformations – design and implement the core infrastructure, platforms, and services that enable scalable products in AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • Collaborate across disciplines – work closely with fellow engineers, AI Experts and business transformation leaders as a technical peer to deliver production-ready cloud platforms that create real impact for our clients

  • Enable AI and event-driven systems at scale – design, deploy and evolve CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures, networking, security, and the infrastructure that ML/AI workloads run on

  • Design and maintain high-quality, reusable infrastructure code – using Terraform, Python, and modern cloud tooling to automate everything from environments to deployments with reliability and scalability in mind

  • Translate architecture into business value – explain cloud decisions clearly to stakeholders so teams understand why a design matters, not just how it works

What makes us the right choice for you

  • Step into a role where you contribute ideas, drive innovation, and directly influence how organizations modernize their cloud, automate systems, and scale digital products

  • Apply and further expand your deep cloud expertise – work across AWS, Azure, and GCP, design and operate real-world infrastructures, and grow through hands-on projects and complex architectural challenges

  • Exchange at eye level with experienced cloud engineers – leveraging peer sparring, architectural reviews, and continuous feedback to sharpen both technical and leadership skills

  • Advance your own skills through GAIN®, our certified education and training portfolio, and extend your impact by sharing your knowledge and enthusiasm with others

  • Work alongside clients as a valued team member – building relationships based on trust, shared goals, and face-to-face collaboration whenever it matters most

  • Thrive in a culture that values autonomy, curiosity, and bold thinking – where your voice matters, experimentation is encouraged, and your ideas turn into impactful solutions that are recognized and rewarded

  • Join a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and just the right amount of nerdy – where learning and laughter go hand in hand


What makes you shine

You’re an experienced problem solver – with a passion for building and scaling cloud platforms that power real AI and data solutions. You’ll thrive with us if you bring:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in consulting, strategy, or data/AI-driven environments – showing your passion for (cloud) technology and your ability to deliver reliable, production-ready cloud infrastructure and platforms

  • Sharp analytical and technical skills – you excel at both problem-solving and executing solutions that bridge business and technology

  • Strong developer skills – Git is your standard, and writing high-quality, maintainable code is important to you

  • A hands-on, growth mindset – you take ownership of your work, embrace challenges, and dive confidently into new cloud technologies or complex technical problems

  • Driven by curiosity, collaboration, and growth – you enjoy learning, support others, and contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment

  • A strong academic track record (STEM field preferred), fluency in both English and German (written and spoken), and willingness to travel regularly to client sites

If you're hesitating because you don't meet every requirement, don't let that hold you back. Strong candidates often underestimate how well they fit a role. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply!

Where you’ll work

Most projects require working onsite at client locations throughout Germany (and occasionally Europe) for several days per week.

While our main office is located in Heidelberg, many of our team members are based across various cities in Germany. This reflects our flexible and distributed team structure, which means that relocation is not required.
At the same time, as we continue to grow our Heidelberg office, being located within reasonable travel distance is an advantage and helps facilitate collaboration.

In their own words

"Working as a cloud engineer at Rewire means taking ideas and shaping them into reliable, scalable cloud platforms. I move from designing architectures and trying out new approaches to building and running them in production. The variety in this work keeps things challenging and allows me to continuously grow as an engineer. Alongside client projects, we also develop and refine internal cloud automations, always looking for smarter and more efficient ways to work. And best of all, I get to do this with a great group of people!" – Thomas Bennis, Senior Cloud Engineer at Rewire

 

Sound like your kind of team?

Perfect! If you’re up for an exciting new challenge and want to make real impact with data & AI, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now! And let’s see where this journey takes us.

Questions? Feel free to ask them via ----- – we’re happy to chat.

 

Who you are matters to us!

We welcome all applicants – regardless of gender, background, or LGBT+ identity – because diversity and inclusion are core values for us. We are convinced that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and success. 

We believe diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to building a more diverse engineering team and particularly encourage women and other underrepresented groups in technology to apply.

  • Sie kombinieren starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit einer kommerziellen Denkweise

Become part of our community – we look forward to meeting you!

  • As a Technical Project Manager (all genders), you steer high-end window campaigns with high quality and aesthetic standards for our client in the luxury sector.

jobs.title: Senior Simulation Engineer, Computational Physics
jobs.description:
Senior Simulation Engineer, Computational Physics

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. You will own a selected set of the models, stretching over domains, e.g. microwave physics to plasma radiation.These models will be used by the design team to compute load cases, assess system-level tradeoffs, perform numerical optimization, and simulate the whole machine as a single system. You will own these models end-to-end, from definitions of inputs and outputs, to implementation correctness, and software efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify and implement the simulators. Depending on the simulation needs, you will implement a simulator from scratch or wrap an existing tool into our platform, and make sure the model is properly interfaced with our codebase.

  • Co-define the input and output interfaces. Work together with the engineering teams to update the data model for input and output to ensure it captures correctly the relevant design specifications.

  • Ensure correctness. Ensure simulation pipelines are tested, verified, validated and work correctly as the design evolves. Where needed, help scoping and contribute to validation in hardware tests.

  • Exercise the models. Support the integrated design team with dedicated studies to inform design tradeoffs.

  • Expose simulators as a service to humans and agents. Create dashboard, online tools, and interactive reports to visualize model prediction and uncertainties and explore the model behaviour, that can be easily used by the entire Alpha design team.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Your knowledge ranges across physics, geometry, and numerical methods. You feel comfortable jumping into the complex 3D geometry of a stellarator and the many physics phenomena happening in a stellarator.

  • You have technical qualifications and experience. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have built simulation tools encompassing numerical algorithms, geometry, and physics.

  • You build in code like a software engineer. You are familiar with git, CI/CD, the PyData stack, autodifferentiation packages (like JAX or PyTorch), and you have built real tools, not just scripts.

  • You choose tools appropriately. Given a simulation need, you reach for the most appropriate tool, being a simple simulator or a commercial multiphysics package.

  • You're proactive. You find the gap before it becomes a problem, prioritize effectively, and argue for the next step.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at PF3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers.

While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

jobs.description:
Security Operations Manager

About the role

We're looking for someone to build our security operations capability from the ground up. This covers how we spot when something is wrong, how we respond when it is, and how we keep improving both. It's a hands-on leadership role for the early stages, so you'll be setting things up and running them, not managing a large team from day one.

You'll design how we do detection and monitoring for security, decide the right mix of in-house work and outsourced support, and set up how alerts are handled and escalated. You'll also lead how we respond to incidents, working closely with our engineering and reliability colleagues, since a lot of this sits alongside how they already keep our services running.

This is a deeply collaborative role. In particular you'll work hand in hand with our site reliability engineering (SRE) team, since much of security monitoring and response builds on the same tooling and ways of working they already use to keep our services running. We want to avoid heavy, siloed processes and instead build a lean, practical capability that fits how the rest of the business works, bringing in specialist help where it makes sense.

Job responsibilities

  • Set up detection and monitoring for security across the platform and wider IT, including the tooling, dashboards and log sources needed to investigate quickly

  • Decide how much we run ourselves and where we use outsourced monitoring or response, and own that relationship

  • Set up how security alerts are handled, owned and escalated, starting with working-hours coverage

  • Lead how we respond to security incidents, including playbooks for the most likely scenarios, a single place of record, and regular practice exercises

  • Work with the reliability team on resilience and recovery, including backups, restore testing and disaster-recovery exercises

  • Triage vulnerabilities found in our running systems and infrastructure into a shared tracker

  • Run exercises that test and improve our defences over time

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Experience building or leading security operations, or detection and response, ideally somewhere you had to set it up rather than inherit it

  • Strong grounding in detection and monitoring, including logging, alerting and building useful detections

  • Experience leading incident response, including playbooks, exercises and learning from what happened

  • A strongly collaborative approach, with real experience working alongside site reliability or platform engineering teams and sharing tooling where it makes sense

  • Experience choosing and managing outsourced monitoring or response providers

  • A practical, low-drama approach that keeps things proportionate

  • Willing to explore where AI can help in security monitoring and response, and pragmatic about applying it where it genuinely fits the use case

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Built a security operations capability in a scale-up

  • Worked in InsurTech, FinTech or another regulated industry

  • Experience with detection and response in cloud-based environments

  • Run tabletop or disaster-recovery exercises

  • Experience with offensive and defensive testing to sharpen defences

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

jobs.title: Automated Testing Module Lead
jobs.description:
Automated Testing Module Lead

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Take over, structure, and give a clear mandate to our existing team of four engineers, while building the case and the roadmap to scale the module to around eight by mid-2027.
    Scenario & Simulation Engineering: Drive the design of a versioned scenario library covering nominal, edge, off-nominal, and contested flight conditions, expanding into Monte Carlo and multi-agent testing, and bring a team with no prior simulation experience up that curve.

  • Execution Strategy & Gating: Establish what tests run across SITL, HITL, and CI, defining gating policies, telemetry capture, deterministic replay, and coverage analytics.

  • Interface & Boundary Ownership: Negotiate, then maintain, strong, written technical boundaries with Tooling (who provide the simulation platform) and co-ownership splits with Validation (who define acceptance criteria and own final sign-off).

  • Sim-to-Real Correlation: Correlate simulation models against real flight data to continuously measure and close the sim-to-real gap, ensuring green test gates reflect real-world flight readiness.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years in automated testing, simulation-based validation, or test engineering for complex physical / hardware-in-the-loop systems (e.g., Autonomous Driving, Aerospace, Defense, Robotics).
    Scenario & Simulation Depth: Hands-on experience designing scenario-based test suites on a simulation platform and defining coverage that genuinely catches defects. This is the capability our current team lacks, and therefore the most valuable thing you can bring.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on proficiency in Python, C++, Linux, Docker, and CI environments, with deep domain expertise in scenario design, SITL/HITL execution, and simulation tools.

  • Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to step into an existing engineering team, establish immediate clarity, and manage distributed engineers (Paris and Lausanne) effectively**, including engineers more senior than you in years of experience**.

  • Validation Mindset: A rigorous, analytical approach to noisy physical metrics, false positives, and flaky test environments, instinctively questioning what a passing test proves.

  • Cross-Functional Diplomacy: Track record of defining and holding clear interfaces with platform providers and internal customer teams.
    Bonus: Background in defense/aerospace flight software, control systems, or experience closing sim-to-real fidelity gaps.

  • Location & Travel: Based in Paris or Lausanne, with travel between sites. Working-
    level English.

What We Offer

  • Immediate Impact: Take over an established mandate with an existing team and pre-built simulation platform, delivering test capability in weeks rather than building from scratch.

  • High System Scope: Own the entire scenario library and execution strategy across our autonomy stack.
    Direct Mission Impact: Build test pipelines that directly accelerate the deployment of resilient autonomous systems in real-world defense environments.
    Cross-Functional Ownership: Work closely with Tooling, Validation, GNC, Perception, and Embedded SW teams to shape the future of flight-software reliability.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)
jobs.description:
Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)

À propos

Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain.

Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact.

 
 

Rôle

Nous recherchons un Technicien Qualité pour rejoindre notre bureau de Paris. En travaillant sur le terrain aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de qualité, vous veillerez à ce que la qualité soit intégrée à nos produits, du prototype jusqu'à la livraison au client. Vous rapporterez au Responsable Qualité.

 
 

Responsabilités

Support à la fabrication de prototypes :

  • Fournir un support qualité lors de l'assemblage des prototypes, en veillant à ce que les constructions soient conformes aux plans, aux instructions de travail et aux spécifications.

  • Identifier et documenter les pièces non conformes, soutenir le traitement et les actions correctives aux côtés de l'équipe d'ingénierie.

  • Aider à définir les méthodes d'inspection et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux composants.

 

Revue de premier article (FAI) :

  • Réaliser des revues de premier article sur les pièces de développement.

  • Préparer et maintenir les rapports FAI avec une traçabilité complète des résultats d'inspection.

  • Assurer le suivi des conclusions de la FAI et veiller à ce que les actions correctives soient clôturées avant la mise en production.

 

Mur Qualité – Produits en développement :

  • Gérer le point de contrôle du mur qualité, en vérifiant que chaque unité de développement répond aux critères définis avant de passer à la phase suivante.

  • Tenir à jour les registres du mur qualité et donner de la visibilité sur l'état des produits et les motifs de blocage.

  • Faire remonter les défauts récurrents à l'Ingénierie Qualité et à la Conception pour résolution.

 

Support après-vente et tri chez le client :

  • Participer aux activités de support après-vente, y compris l'inspection sur site et le tri des produits chez les clients si nécessaire.

  • Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour identifier les unités non conformes, isoler les produits défectueux et documenter les résultats.

  • Agir en tant que représentant qualité sur site, assurant la liaison entre le client et les équipes internes pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes de qualité.

  • Remonter les observations du terrain au centre de développement pour piloter les actions correctives et l'amélioration des produits.

 

Système Qualité et Amélioration Continue :

  • Veiller à ce que les rapports d'inspection et de non-conformité soient correctement documentés dans les outils appropriés (Jira, Confluence ou QMS).

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus d'inspection et des critères du mur qualité au fil du temps.

 

Prérequis

  • Diplôme technique en qualité, génie mécanique, fabrication ou domaine connexe.

  • Première expérience dans un rôle d'inspection qualité ou de qualité fabrication, idéalement dans les secteurs de l'aérospatiale, de la défense ou de la haute technologie.

  • Capacité à lire des dessins d'ingénierie et à utiliser les outils d'inspection standards (pieds à coulisse, micromètres, etc.).

  • La connaissance des processus de revue de premier article (FAI) est un plus.

  • Connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et EN 9100.

  • Minutieux, rigoureux et à l'aise pour travailler en atelier.

  • Esprit d'équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

  • Bon niveau d'anglais ; disponibilité pour se déplacer sur les sites des clients si nécessaire.

  • Adhésion totale à la mission de Harmattan AI et volonté de s'investir pleinement pour soutenir notre croissance.

 

Nous avons hâte de découvrir comment vous pouvez aider à façonner l'avenir des systèmes de défense autonomes chez Harmattan AI.
