jobs.title: Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy
jobs.description:
Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • US

Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.

About the Role

The Global GTM Strategy, Planning and Operations team at Cloudflare supports our high-growth Sales organization through scalable, AI supported GTM planning and operations. We focus on thoughtful planning of sales capacity, segmentation, territory carving, quota setting, and compensation design while ensuring clear rules of engagement for our Sales Team. Our goal is to establish a cohesive, consistent process framework that can support high growth, enable the Company's strategy, and accelerate Cloudflare's leadership in the developer and AI-native business segments.

As the Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy, you will design and manage Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plans across all customer facing teams including Sales, Technical Sales, Partner Sales, and Customer Success & Experience, to ensure they are motivating, aligned with Cloudflare's strategy, and industry leading. This is a high visibility role with significant executive engagement, including leading C-level discussions with our CRO, CFO, CPO, and COO, and serving as the design authority on the Executive Compensation Steering Committee.

You will architect new compensation metrics that reflect how Cloudflare monetizes a developer first, AI supportive business - including consumption, adoption, and platform attach - and ensure roles, territories, and quotas align with compensation plans to achieve our GTM objectives. You will establish a governance framework for efficient compensation planning and partner closely with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure effective implementation and accurate payouts. A strong understanding of SaaS bookings, monetization approaches, and consumption and adoption models is essential.

The scope of executive influence, the architectural work required to support our developer/AI business model, and the AI-native transformation of the compensation design function make this seat fundamental to our GTM execution strategy.

Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Design Authority

  • Lead the Sales Compensation Design Process with the Executive Steering Committee, including CRO, CFO, and CPO level stakeholders.
  • Drive C-level discussions on compensation philosophy, pay-for-performance outcomes, and strategic trade-offs; develop recommendation decks and own the narrative through approval.
  • Architect new metrics that align seller incentives with Cloudflare's developer platform and AI product strategy (e.g., Workers consumption, AI Gateway adoption, platform attach, multi-product penetration).
  • Create a 3-year roadmap for the Sales Compensation Design function.

AI-Native Compensation Design

  • Build the AI Compensation Design Framework and Application - an internal capability that uses AI to accelerate plan modeling, scenario simulation, payout forecasting, and what-if analysis across thousands of sellers and territories.
  • Leverage AI to design high-quality SPIFFs and incentive structures, including generating candidate designs, simulating seller behavior, and stress-testing against historical data before launch.
  • Track ROI of comp plans, SPIFFs, and incentive programs using AI-driven analytics - moving from lagging reporting to predictive measurement of plan effectiveness, seller behavior change, and revenue lift.
  • Develop AI-powered pay-for-performance reporting that surfaces insights for executives, managers, and sellers in real time, replacing static quarterly reviews with continuous intelligence.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Collaborate with GTM Strategy, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, and Product to ensure effective deployment of compensation plans and GTM strategy.
  • Lead compensation enablement and change management for the global Sales team, including AI-assisted communications, FAQ generation, and plan-acceptance workflows.
  • Design SPIFFs and incentive strategies that balance long-term strategic bets with short-term revenue goals.
  • Partner with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure design intent translates into accurate, auditable payouts.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 15+ years of experience in Sales Compensation Design in a fast-paced tech company or as a management consultant.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and AI-augmented workflows - whether through prior comp design work, analytics, or strategic projects. Comfort building or directing the build of AI-powered internal applications is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to architect new metrics for emerging business models (consumption, AI monetization).
  • Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives.
  • Proven experience driving Executive Steering Committee meetings and owning the decision narrative end-to-end.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives to completion across Finance, HR, IT, Product, and GTM.
  • Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Bonus Points

The ideal candidate combines a strong background in sales strategy and compensation design with genuine curiosity about applying AI to transform the function. Candidates will have exceptional stakeholder management skills, executive presence, and the confidence to manage evolving strategies in a high-growth company.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $230,000 - $317,000
  • For California (excluding Bay Area), Washington, Washington DC, NY and NJ based hires: $220,000 - $303,000
  • For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $275,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

jobs.title: Ads Quality Rater - Dutch (Netherlands)
jobs.description:
Ads Quality Rater - Dutch (Netherlands)

Overzicht

Kom de toekomst van het internet vormgeven met je dagelijkse internetvaardigheden!

Als Ads Quality Rater beoordeel en evalueer je internetadvertenties om ze beter en relevanter te maken voor eindgebruikers zoals jijzelf.

Met andere woorden, je vertelt het systeem hoe goed of hoe slecht een advertentie is op basis van je begrip van de trefwoorden die bij elke advertentie verstrekt worden. Je beoordeelt advertenties zowel in het Engels als in het Nederlands.

Deze functie is ideaal voor mensen die:

· Dagelijks op het internet surfen

· Vaak grote zoekmachines gebruiken

· Advertenties herkennen wanneer ze verschijnen

· Houden van online onderzoek doen over verschillende onderwerpen

Daarnaast moeten alle Ads Quality Raters een geheimhoudingsovereenkomst ondertekenen en slagen voor een door de klant verstrekte test voordat ze worden aangenomen.

Deze cruciale stappen garanderen geheimhouding van de klant en een hoog kwaliteitsniveau.

Projectdetails

Functieomschrijving: Ads Quality Rater

Salaris: per taak (ca. $17 USD per uur)

Locatie: op afstand, Nederland

Uren: bepaal je eigen schema gebaseerd op het volgende: minimale inzet is 10 uur per week. Je kunt ervoor kiezen om tot 20 uur per week te werken (als het project dit toelaat).

Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk

Dienstverband: freelance; betaling elke 2 weken

Projectduur: 12 maanden (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging)

De hoeveelheid van data kan van week tot week variëren. Sommige weken is er meer data om te beoordelen, andere weken minder. Van alle Ads Quality Raters wordt verwacht dat zij minimaal 10 uur per week werken.

Aanwervingsproces en stappen

Welo Data streeft naar een inclusief en rechtvaardig wervingsproces. Alle kandidaten dienen de volgende stappen doorlopen om in aanmerking te komen voor dit project:

• Sollicitatie kandidaat

• Welo Data beoordeling sollicitatie

• Kennis, evaluatie en kwalificatie kandidaat

• Welo Data’s klant beoordeling

• Definitieve goedkeuring

Het wervingsproces kan tot 14 dagen in beslag nemen.

Ervaring en vereisten

  • Vloeiend in Nederlands (geschreven en gesproken)
  • Conversationeel in Engels
  • Betrouwbaar computersysteem en internetverbinding
  • Bekend met het gebruik van online zoekmachines
  • Kan instructies in het Engels ontvangen en begrijpen en kan voldoen aan de projectconventies en -regels die door de klant worden verwacht
  • Bereid om een geheimhoudingsverklaring te tekenen ter bescherming van de klant
  • Voldoet aan de leermodules en een vereiste kwaliteitstest ontworpen door onze klant voordat het werk begint

Compensation

Additional Information

Overige informatie

Preventie van fraude

Projecten zoals deze zijn over de hele wereld grote doelwitten van fraude. Daarom voert Welo Data gedurende het hele proces fraudecontroles uit om ervoor te zorgen dat het programma wordt nageleefd. Alle accounts die frauduleus worden bevonden, worden onmiddellijk van het project verwijderd.

Over Welo Data

Welo Data is een wereldwijd data- en vertaalbedrijf met kantoren over de hele wereld. We hebben achter de schermen gewerkt aan een aantal van de grootste technische projecten ooit, van datalokalisatie en vertaling tot generatieve AI en deep learning. We zijn buitengewoon trots op onze klanten, onze medewerkers en de eindgebruikers van alle projecten waar we aan werken.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager (all genders)
JOIN US

Ab sofort suchen wir für unser Team am Standort Stuttgart einen Senior Project Manager (all genders).

Werde Teil unserer Community – wir freuen uns auf dich!


WHAT YOU DO

  • Eigenständige, vollumfängliche Projektleitung komplexer Projekte von der Planung über die Kostenkontrolle bis zur Abrechnung

  • Inhaltliche Kundenführung, -beratung und -entwicklung für Kunden aus Bereichen wie z.B. Retail, Sports, Fashion, Beauty und Luxury in enger Abstimmung mit dem Key Account Director

  • Transparente Budgetplanung und finanzielle Gesamtverantwortung für das zugeordnete Projektportfolio sowie fachliche Anleitung von juniorigen Kolleg:innen im Team

  • Souveräne Steuerung vielfältiger Formate wie Retail Kampagnen, Events und Brand Experiences

  • Interdisziplinäre Schnittstellenkoordination interner Teams, externer Dienstleister:innen und Kooperationspartner:innen unter strikter Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards, Budgets und Timelines


WHO YOU ARE

  • Min. 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement mit Fokus auf Retail, Sports, Fashion oder Luxury
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Anleitung und Entwicklung von Projektteams sowie ein ausgeprägtes kaufmännisches Denken und strategische Beratungskompetenz
  • Begeisterung für ein dynamisches Aufgabenfeld von der strategischen Konzeption bis zur präzisen operativen Umsetzung
  • Interdisziplinäre Denkweise, ausgeprägter Teamgeist und Souveränität auch in intensiven Projektphasen stets den Überblick zu behalten
  • Exzellente Präsentations-, Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsskills auf Deutsch und Englisch


WHAT TO EXPECT

  • DIVERSITY & PEOPLE: Come as you are! Bei LIGANOVA wird eine Kultur der Inklusion gelebt und Diversity fasziniert uns. Einzigartigkeit wird zelebriert und gefördert, weshalb uns die gemeinsame Mission „Create the best version of yourself“ eint. Denn wir finden, dass gerade Vielfalt das größte kreative Potential birgt.
  • GREEN MINDSET: Innovative Lösungen und unser Green Board geben Impulse für mehr Nachhaltigkeit im Office und darüber hinaus. Mit der Initiative Green Campaign Cycle führen wir unsere Kunden proaktiv an das Thema Green Transformation heran und stehen bei der Umsetzung mit unserer Expertise zur Seite.

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
 
Mission: Join us as a Frontend Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.
 

➡️  Your future team

As a Frontend Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
 
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. We almost completed a migration to React. Now is an exciting time to join, especially if you want to hone your expertise in React over the coming years!

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.
  2. Attention to detail: you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right.
  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive (B2C)
jobs.description:
Senior Performance Marketing Executive (B2C)
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.


Consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated quickly over the last two years, and paid media is a huge part of how we reach more drivers and grow the business.

We're looking for a brilliant Senior Performance Marketing Executive to take day-to-day ownership of our paid digital activity - with one big goal: help us get more from every pound we spend.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves performance marketing at the detail level. You'll be in Google Ads regularly, analysing search terms, adjusting budgets and bids, spotting wasted spend, testing new approaches and working out where we can improve conversion and scale efficiently.

Paid search will be at the heart of the role, and you'll also help us explore and grow channels like Paid Social, Display and Programmatic, testing where they can add incremental value to our existing activity. 

You'll sit within our B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Consumer Growth Marketing Manager, and work closely with our Content Creator, Design, Commercial and wider Marketing teams.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, perhaps from an agency or fast-paced in-house environment, who wants more ownership, more visibility and more opportunity to influence what happens next.


What you'll do

  • 🚀 Own our paid media campaigns: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and Meta, with paid search as your core focus initially.

  • 💰 Make our spend work harder: Identify wasted spend, underperforming campaigns and opportunities to improve efficiency, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause, reduce or reallocate budget.

  • 📈 Optimise towards the outcomes that matter: Look beyond clicks and leads to understand which campaigns and audiences are driving better-quality customers and orders, and use that insight to improve performance.

  • 🖥️ Help us grow Display and Programmatic: Identify opportunities across prospecting and retargeting, shape audiences and creative approaches, launch tests, analyse performance and recommend where there is a genuine opportunity to scale.

  • 📊 Stay close to performance: Monitor spend, pacing and key metrics, spot changes quickly and turn the numbers into clear, practical recommendations.

  • 🧪 Test, learn and improve: Work with our Content Creator and Design team to test messaging, creative, formats, audiences and landing-page approaches.

  • 🎯 Keep campaigns clean and measurable: Make sure tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and campaign structures are set up properly so we can trust the data we're using to make decisions.

  • 🌐 Help improve what happens after the click: Support campaign landing pages and other digital experiences, including drafting copy and building or updating pages using our web tools when needed.

  • 🤝 Make campaigns happen: Coordinate briefs, creative, links, tracking and launches across the team so activity gets live quickly.


What you'll need

Strong hands-on paid search experience. You're confident building, managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns yourself, from search terms and match types to bidding, budgets and campaign structure.

A proper performance mindset. You naturally look at an account and ask: Where are we wasting money? What could perform better? What should we test next?

Good commercial judgement. You know the cheapest click or lead isn't always the best one, and you're interested in what actually drives better-quality customers and orders.

Confidence managing paid media budgets. You're comfortable keeping an eye on pacing, spotting where performance is changing and recommending where spend should move.

Experience with Display or Programmatic. Ideally, you've worked hands-on with Display campaigns, DV360, Campaign Manager 360 or similar platforms. You don't need to be a programmatic specialist, but you should understand the basics and be excited to help us grow this area.

Some paid social experience. Experience with Meta Ads Manager or other paid social platforms would be useful.

You're comfortable with the technical detail. You understand why conversion tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and clean campaign setup matter, and you're happy digging into data to work out what's going on.

Around 2-4 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in an agency, media business or fast-paced in-house environment. We're flexible on exact years - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.

Most importantly, you enjoy doing the work. You like being in-platform, finding opportunities and making things better, and you're proactive, commercially minded, low-ego and great to work with. Things move quickly here, priorities change and everyone pitches in, so you'll thrive if you're happy getting stuck in, helping others and figuring things out as you go.


Why else you'll love it here
  • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

  • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! 🎁 Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

  • 🏆 Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership

    • Things to note
  • 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies

  • 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!

    • About us
     
    The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 
     
    We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.
     
    Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 
     
    We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.

Forward Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Forward Deployment Strategist

À propos de nAIxt Consulting / ILLUIN Technology

nAIxt Consulting est la practice conseil d'ILLUIN Technology, société née en 2017 au cœur de CentraleSupélec, l'un des clusters IA de référence en Europe. Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Le rôle

Nous recherchons plusieurs Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS) pour rejoindre nôtre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

We’re looking for an evidence-based, customer-centric, and innovative Product Manager to join our growing product org. As a Growth PM, you will play a key role in our product-led growth and self-serve initiatives within our Product Growth team. This team is focused on identifying where the product can do more to help customers realize value and where that value can translate into durable business growth.

Your goal will be to understand the core value levers of our product and use strong growth instincts to drive activation, adoption, monetization, retention, and expansion. We believe the strongest product-led growth comes from helping customers realize value through thoughtful product experiences, not from forcing growth at the expense of customer trust.

Reporting to the Growth Group Product Manager, you will build growth loops, develop hypotheses, run experiments, and turn insight into product improvements that create value for both customers and the business. You will partner closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and other cross-functional teammates to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate is curious, proactive, customer-centric, and energized by solving growth problems through product. You have strong product judgment, a bias toward learning, and a demonstrated ability to turn customer insight and data into measurable impact.

You have experience in product-led growth and self-serve product development, with a strong understanding of funnels, loops, lifecycle optimization, and experimentation. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and you know how to use both quantitative and qualitative inputs to make sound product decisions.

You are self-sufficient with data, comfortable exploring dashboards and analyzing funnels, and able to use evidence to influence priorities. You are also fluent in modern AI tools and concepts, whether through building AI-powered features or using AI to improve the quality and speed of your work.

You are a strong cross-functional partner who collaborates effectively with engineering, design, research, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders. You care deeply about craft and customer experience, and you believe the best growth comes from helping users realize value faster and more often, not from adding friction or compromising product quality.

  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, learnings, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leaders

  • 3-5 years in product management, including meaningful experience in product-led growth and/or experimentation-focused roles in modern B2B SaaS environments

  • Strong quantitative business acumen and comfort using data to identify opportunities, evaluate performance, and inform decisions

Talent Acquisition Manager | Tech (f/m/d)

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your role

As Talent Acquisition Manager — Tech at bunch, you will own end-to-end hiring across Engineering, Product, Design and Analytics. You will build high-quality technical pipelines, translate business needs into structured hiring strategies, and partner with technical leaders to make sound, evidence-based hiring decisions.

You will:

  • Own assigned technical searches from kick-off through accepted offer and onboarding handover, turning role outcomes into clear scorecards, interview plans, sourcing strategies and delivery forecasts

  • Build targeted outbound pipelines, engage passive technical talent with relevant communication and develop reusable talent maps and relationships across referrals and technical communities

  • Partner with hiring managers on talent availability, location, compensation, level and search feasibility, while maintaining a high bar for interview quality, timely feedback and consistent assessment

  • Manage competing searches through explicit priorities, milestones, pipeline coverage and risk signals, keeping Ashby workflows, reporting and role-level forecasts accurate

  • Create a strong candidate experience and close effectively by understanding motivation, concerns and decision criteria early, then communicating clearly throughout the process

  • Use AI and automation to improve research, preparation, reporting and follow-up while retaining human judgment, data quality and accountability

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, with meaningful ownership of technical roles in a fast-moving environment

  • A mix of agency and startup experience is a plus

  • You have hired for a diverse set of roles and seniorities within Engineering, Product, Design, and Data

  • You are intrinsically self-starting: you identify gaps, form a point of view, propose solutions and close loops without needing detailed direction

  • You are resilient and persistent when searches, stakeholders or candidates become difficult, while recognising when to change course

  • You are curious about technical work, talent markets and the business, and learn quickly enough to calibrate credibly with Engineering, Product and Analytics leaders

  • You are a creative sourcer who develops new talent pools, messages and routes to market when the standard process is not enough

  • You value structured kick-offs, scorecards, ATS discipline and data, but understand that process supports judgment rather than replacing it

  • You use recruiting data, AI and automation responsibly without outsourcing human judgment

What success looks like

  • Own it: Take end-to-end accountability for searches, candidate commitments and stakeholder follow-through. Surface risks early with a proposed solution and learn openly from mistakes.

  • Aim for impact: Focus on hiring work that moves the needle. Connect priorities to business and team outcomes, make explicit trade-offs and keep quality as part of speed.

  • Empower others: Invest time, empathy and recruiting expertise in candidates, hiring managers and teammates. Improve interview quality and help others make better decisions.

  • Always be curious: Ask why, challenge assumptions and continuously learn about technical roles, the talent market and bunch’s business. Turn each search into reusable insight.

  • Enjoy the ride: Bring warmth, authenticity and constructive energy to demanding work. Stay calm under pressure, recognise progress and help the team navigate setbacks together.

Workplace & benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid work with 3 days per week in the office in Mitte

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks per year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team interview with Roberto — 45 min: Motivation and the five values that matter most for operating in a fast-paced environment.

  2. Technical recruiting live case — 60 min: A conversational interview about real and situational recruiting decisions, stakeholder management, and team dynamics. No take-home assignment.

  3. Cross-functional round — 3 × 30 min: Conversations with an Engineering or Product Leaders, People Partner and People Lead.

Questions? Reach out to

  • About bunch — Our mission, product and journey so far

  • Case Studies — About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights — Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary — Explore commonly used private-market terms

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.


____

At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants.

jobs.description:
(Senior) Full-Stack Engineer | Frontend-leaning | Platform Team (f/m/d) | Berlin

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your role

You’ll join our Platform team as a Full Stack Engineer with a frontend focus, building the foundational product experiences and services that power bunch. We’re looking for someone who sees product development as a craft - a blend of technical excellence, user-centered thinking, and cross-functional collaboration.

Whether you’re shaping frontend architecture, contributing to backend services, maintaining our Design System, or implementing features end to end, your work will have a direct impact on thousands of users managing billions in assets. We offer you freedom and ownership to build the right solutions and influence the product roadmap.

Top responsibilities

  • Build robust, scalable, and well-tested full-stack product features, with a strong focus on frontend quality, using modern frameworks and our in-house Design System

  • Collaborate with PMs, Designers, QAs, and Engineers in the Platform Core team to ship high-quality features quickly

  • Contribute to and evolve our frontend architecture, backend services, tooling, and design system

  • Ensure a great developer experience and continuously improve performance, reliability, and maintainability across the stack

  • Write meaningful unit and E2E tests

  • Actively shape product solutions by participating in discovery, feedback rounds, and design critiques

If you're applying as a Senior:

  • Take ownership across the stack, with particular depth in the frontend domain, and influence platform-wide decisions

  • Drive alignment between design and development, and collaborate on challenging UX cases

  • Own and evolve our in-house Design System alongside the design team

  • Guide the team in architecture and performance decisions

  • Mentor and support other engineers

About You

To thrive in our Platform Core team, you combine a love for building excellent UIs with the ability to work confidently across the stack and a pragmatic, product-first mindset. You're a strong communicator, a team player, and someone who thrives in a growing, fast-paced environment where asking "why" is encouraged.

You...

  • Have 5+ years (Senior) of experience building product applications across the stack, with clear frontend depth

  • Are fluent in TypeScript, comfortable with modern frontend frameworks, and able to contribute to Node.js backend services

  • Have experience working with Design Systems

    • for Senior: also experience building or maintaining custom ones

  • Are familiar with unit and E2E testing (Vitest, Playwright, or equivalents)

  • Understand UI/UX principles and care about building elegant, accessible, and usable interfaces

  • Can operate in ambiguity and turn loosely defined ideas into working software

  • Have experience in a startup or scaleup environment

Nice to have:

  • Previous exposure to fintech or highly regulated domains

  • Experience with zod (or any other form validation tools)

  • Worked with data visualisations (e.g., tables, charts)

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: Svelte + SvelteKit but moving towards React + TanStack, TypeScript, MeltUI (headless components) but moving towards Shadcn, Felte + zod

  • Testing: Vitest (unit), Playwright (E2E)

  • Design System: Custom-built (MeltUI)

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, MySQL, Sequelize

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (K8S) on top of AWS

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Interview Process

  • First interview with the People team (30 min): get acquainted with bunch and to understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 min): this conversation with an Engineering Manager will cover product-focused culture and values, including collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

  • Technical Interview (60 min): this interview in the form of a technical conversation with two engineers will focus on collaborative problem-solving, starting with open-ended questions and progressing to more specific challenges or short algorithm tasks.

  • Final Round: Meet our VP of Engineering (45 min): learn about ways of working, vision for bunch, and team culture.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Engineering Lead (m/w/d)

At GALVANY, our goal is to make climate-neutral living a reality for everyone. We focus on execution – developing concrete, smart solutions and making heat pumps, battery storage, and smart metering easy to access, reliable, and affordable. GALVANY-Tech drives the energy transition through software. We're building an AI-based Operating System for sales, planning, installation and operation of heat pumps and integrated energy systems – from single-family homes to multi-unit buildings, and across our Energy Community as a Virtual Power Plant.

We are a profitable green-tech startup and believe that sustainable impact and long-term growth are only possible when grounded in a healthy business model. Driven by customer value, clarity, and responsibility, we stand for high-quality heating solutions and an environment where people take responsibility and drive lasting impact.

The Role

As an Engineering Lead at GALVANY, you will shape the technical direction of critical product domains within our AI-based Operating System. Whether you're driving our ERP, automation, and AI agent systems or our CRM and customer-facing apps – you'll own architecture decisions, elevate your team, and bridge the gap between engineering and the wider business. You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to align stakeholders and mentor engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Own architectural decisions for your domain and drive long-term technical vision.

  • Lead a team of engineers: hire, develop, and retain talent through coaching, code reviews, and continuous feedback.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and clear technical guidance.

  • Stay hands-on: contribute directly to the codebase alongside architectural and leadership responsibilities.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Operations to align technical decisions with business goals.

  • Balance innovation with pragmatism – make smart build-vs-buy decisions at system level.

  • Integrate LLMs and AI agents into product workflows where they create real value.

  • Drive operational excellence: observability, reliability, and incident response.

Tech Stack: Backend with GoLang and Laravel; ML with Python, PyTorch, and LLMs; Frontend with React, Tailwind, and Shadcn; Mobile with Flutter; General tools including Azure, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Kafka, Benthos (data pipeline), n8n / Kestra (workflow engine), and low-code process automation platforms.

Requirements

  • Experience. 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years of technical leadership in high-performance environments (e.g. fast-scaling startups or similar).

  • Track Record. Proven end-to-end responsibility in software engineering and technical leadership. From ideation to release.

  • Background. Strong background in relevant fields, e.g. Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar.

  • Technical Skills. Strong system design and coding skills with proficiency in Go, or similar. Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed systems. Fluent in spec-driven, AI-assisted development (e.g. Claude Code).

  • Mindset. Self-driven problem-solving mindset – no need for micromanagement or specific tickets.

  • Technical Aptitude. Technical mindset with a passion for understanding systems, data flows, and integrations, coupled with enthusiasm for continuous learning and problem solving.

  • Language. Fluent in English (C1); German (B2)

Skills and Qualities That Are Important to Us

  • Outcome-Led. You focus on value over volume. You embrace iteration, adapt quickly to new information, and prioritize what moves the needle for business and user.

  • Systems Thinker. You see the bigger picture. You understand how your work connects to the wider ecosystem – ensuring features contribute to a cohesive, scalable whole.

  • Pragmatic. You choose the simplest effective path to solve problems – especially by leveraging AI tools.

  • Customer Champion. You keep the end-user central in all decisions. You seek direct exposure to how customers experience the product.

  • Team Multiplier. You take responsibility for your team's success – setting direction, removing blockers, and developing people. You make the team better, not just the code.

  • Cross-Functional Bridge. You translate between Engineering, Product, and Ops. You build alignment on technical decisions with non-technical stakeholders.

Benefits

  • Strong Growth & High Impact. A unique opportunity to join during a hypergrowth phase and actively contribute to company success.

  • Compensation. Competitive salary and flexible perks (sports, mobility, learning) tailored to your needs.

  • Real-World Impact. Your work drives decarbonization – measurable in CO₂ savings, energy efficiency (kWh), and cost reductions (€).

  • Office. Prime location in Berlin Charlottenburg, regular company events and all-hands. We value in-person collaboration and connection, while partial remote work remains an option.

  • No Corporate Theater. Skip endless alignment meetings, politics and waiting for permission. You talk to the people who matter and ship.

Du begleitest wertvolle Anwendungsfälle von der ersten Idee über Prototyp und Pilot bis in den sicheren produktiven Betrieb. Im Zentrum stehen Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services sowie die Integration von Unternehmensdaten, Prozessen und bestehenden Plattformen.

jobs.description:
Front End Design Engineer

About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

jobs.title: Mission Sales Director, Nordics

Mission Sales Director, Nordics

Role highlights:

  • Missions Sales Director

  • Location: Finland, Sweden, Norway or Denmark

  • Department: Missions Sales

  • Reports to: VP of Mission Sales

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Remote

Why this role matters:

As a Missions Sales Director, you’ll lead sovereign satellite and ISR mission sales to government customers in the Nordics, driving growth, trust, and long-term partnerships that advance ICEYE’s position as the defence-focused space ISR leader.

You will own the full sales cycle for Missions satellite programmes, from identifying and shaping opportunities to closing multi-year deals. By building strategic relationships with governments and key decision-makers, you will expand ICEYE’s presence in the region, deliver sustainable revenue growth, and ensure customer success through close collaboration across ICEYE’s Missions and Data lines of business.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own and drive regional revenue growth for ICEYE’s Missions business in the Nordics.

  • Identify, shape, qualify, and close sovereign satellite and ISR mission opportunities with government customers.

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with government stakeholders, defence organisations, and key decision-makers in the market.

  • Develop and manage a qualified sales pipeline, including capture plans, win strategies, and accurate forecasting.

  • Lead complex strategic sales processes, including opportunity reviews, bid or no-bid decisions, proposal coordination, and commercial positioning.

  • Collaborate across ICEYE’s Missions and Data lines of business to align customer needs, technical capabilities, and delivery plans.

  • Represent ICEYE in-market through customer meetings, industry events, and strategic stakeholder engagement.

  • Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning and decision-making.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of strategic sales or business development experience in the aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation, or related government technology sector.

  • 5+ years of international sales or export experience with complex solutions.

  • Experience selling to government customers, defence organisations, or public sector decision-makers.

  • Existing network across relevant government and government-related organisations in the Nordics

  • Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR, or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR.

  • Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including lead qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping, and deal closure.

  • Professional working proficiency in one or more Nordic languages, with multiple Nordic languages considered a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to travel as required, primarily across the region and to Finland.

Nice to haves:

  • Previous military, defence, intelligence, or security-sector experience.

  • Experience producing capture plans and delivering against win strategies.

  • Track record of closing value-based sales with a strong focus on customer success.

  • Experience leading multi-department sales pursuits, gate reviews, bid processes, and competitive analysis.

  • Experience using Salesforce or another CRM.

  • Sales training in Miller Heiman, Korn Ferry, Shipley, or a similar methodology.

Application Process

  • Assessment

  • Recruiter interview

  • Peer interview

  • VP interview

  • References

  • CEO interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is 100 000 - 150 000 EUR per year, gross, dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us and we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
Was du bei uns machen wirst:

TL;DR

Zasta ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App Stores (schau selbst auf deinem Handy in der Kategorie Finanzen nach). 

Wir bauen kein Unternehmen über Headcount auf. Unsere Teams bestehen aus erfahrenen Expert:innen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit.

Wir suchen einen Chief of Staff mit außergewöhnlich hohem Drive und analytischer Stärke, der direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten strategischen Themen von Zasta arbeitet.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Von Analyse und Business Case über Partnerverhandlung und Scoping bis zu Go-live und messbarem Ergebnis.

  • Top-Profil: Sehr starker akademischer Track Record und typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Erfahrung – z. B. Strategy Consulting + Operator-Rolle, Founders' Office oder General Management.

  • Business-relevante Projekte: Neue Geschäftsmodelle, Partnerschaften, Marketing Channels, regulatorische Themen, Markterweiterungen und andere strategische Initiativen.

  • Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau ist aufgrund unseres regulierten Steuerumfelds zwingend erforderlich.

  • Starkes Gehalt + VSOP, ein klarer Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta (wenn dein Weg dich stattdessen zur eigenen Gründung führt, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit einem Angel-Ticket).

Du bist für relevante strategische Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Business Impact verantwortlich.

Achtung: Das ist keine klassische Stabs-, PMO- oder Koordinationsrolle.

Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, schaffst Struktur, entwickelst Business Cases, identifizierst und verhandelst mit Partner:innen und treibst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations bis zum Go-live.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten.

Deine Verantwortung

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und eng mit dem Management Team an strategisch relevanten Initiativen. Deine Themen sind keine Side Projects. Sie bewegen relevante Line-Items in unserem Business Plan.

Je nach Projekt bedeutet das:

  • neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, auf Machbarkeit prüfen und umsetzen

  • komplexe, unstrukturierte Probleme in klare Hypothesen, Entscheidungen und Workstreams übersetzen

  • Business Cases und Economics entwickeln und kritisch challengen

  • externe Partner:innen identifizieren, bewerten und kommerzielle Konditionen verhandeln

  • gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations MVPs konzipieren und umsetzen

Wir messen dich nicht daran, wie gut deine Slides sind, sondern daran, ob du reale Probleme löst und messbaren Business Impact schaffst.

Zwei beispielhafte ProjekteEinen neuen Geschäftsbereich aufbauen

Rund um das „Altersvorsorgedepot“ entstehen in Deutschland neue Marktchancen.

Du bewertest, welche Rolle Zasta darin spielen sollte – von einer Affiliate-Partnerschaft bis zu einer tief integrierten Produktlösung.

Markt & Strategie → Business Case → Partner Sourcing → Verhandlung → MVP → Tech-Integration → Go-live

Du entwickelst die Economics, identifizierst geeignete Partner:innen, führst Verhandlungen, bewertest regulatorische und operative Anforderungen und bringst die gewählte Lösung gemeinsam mit Product und Tech in unser Produkt. Ein sauberes „Nein“ ist für uns genauso wertvoll wie ein Go-live – wenn die Economics oder Rahmenbedingungen nicht stimmen.

Einen neuen Marketingkanal erschließen

Wir wollen beispielsweise testen, ob sich Out-of-Home zu einem skalierbaren Performance-Marketing-Kanal für Zasta entwickeln kann (und ja: Wir meinen Performance, nicht nur Brand).

Du entwickelst Business Case und Testsetup, bewertest Anbieter und Inventar, verhandelst Konditionen und bringst die Kampagne gemeinsam mit Marketing und Brand live. Wenn Lukas Podolski Teil des Test-Setups sein soll, bekommen wir auch das hin. Anschließend entscheiden wir anhand klarer KPIs: Scale, iterate or stop.

Weitere Projekte können neue Partnerschaften, Pricing, regulatorische Themen, operative Skalierung, M&A, neue Produkte, Vertriebskanäle, vollständig neue Geschäftsmodelle oder interne Strukturen betreffen.


Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

Wir suchen eine außergewöhnlich starke Kombination aus analytischer Exzellenz, Geschwindigkeit und Ownership.

Du bringst mit:

  • einen sehr guten akademischen Track Record und einen sehr guten Abschluss von einer führenden Universität

  • typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung

  • außergewöhnlich starke analytische und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

  • die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell und tief in neue und komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten

  • sehr gutes quantitatives und kommerzielles Urteilsvermögen

  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit Gründer:innen, Senior Stakeholdern, Führungskräften und externen Partner:innen

  • einen sehr hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit sowie einen starken Bias for Action

Wenn du ein Problem siehst, wartest du nicht auf Zuständigkeiten. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel.

Exzellentes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich

Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sprachlich präzise erfassen, formulieren und verhandeln.

Das ist für uns keine formale Anforderung: Zasta bewegt sich in einem stark regulierten Umfeld rund um Steuerberatung, Finanzprozesse und Verbraucherschutz. In vielen Fragestellungen kommt es auf juristische, steuerliche oder regulatorische Nuancen der deutschen Sprache an.

Du musst in der Lage sein, diese selbstständig zu verstehen, kritisch zu hinterfragen und präzise mit Steuerberater:innen, Partner:innen, Anwält:innen, Behörden und internen Teams zu kommunizieren.


Was wir dir bieten:

  • starkes Gehalt + VSOP

  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CEO und Management Team

  • außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum

  • kurze Wege von einer guten Idee zur tatsächlichen Umsetzung

  • einen bewussten Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta

Wir suchen keinen Career Chief of Staff. Wir suchen einen zukünftigen Business Owner.

Im besten Fall übernimmst du nach dieser Rolle einen relevanten Teil des Unternehmens selbst – als Business Owner, VP oder in einer anderen Leadership-Funktion.

Und dein Weg muss nicht bei Zasta enden:

Wir würden uns freuen, wenn wir dich in einigen Jahren bei der Gründung deines eigenen Unternehmens mit einem Angel-Ticket unterstützen könnten.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Gewerbliche Photovoltaik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sales Manager – Gewerbliche Photovoltaik (m/w/d)
Mehr als nur ein Job

Du kennst den gewerblichen Photovoltaikmarkt, kannst Türen öffnen und möchtest einen Geschäftsbereich aktiv mitentwickeln? Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

heimWatt realisiert Photovoltaikprojekte für Gewerbe, Industrie, Wohnungswirtschaft und weitere professionelle Auftraggeber. Durch die Integration wesentlicher Geschäftsbereiche der Energiegewinner Technik GmbH haben wir unsere Kompetenz für größere PV-Projekte deutlich ausgebaut.

Jetzt wollen wir weiter wachsen. Als Sales Manager – Gewerbliche Photovoltaik (m/w/d) entwickelst du neue Kunden, Projekte und Partnerschaften im Bereich von 30 kWp bis 1 MW und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Potenzielle Kunden und Projekte im gewerblichen Photovoltaikbereich identifizierst du gezielt und sprichst die passenden Entscheider direkt an.
  • Die Anforderungen deiner Kunden verstehst du genau und berätst sie zu wirtschaftlich und technisch passenden PV-Lösungen.
  • Gemeinsam mit unserer Projektentwicklung erarbeitest du Angebote, präsentierst diese beim Kunden und führst die Verhandlungen bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Deine Verkaufschancen verfolgst du konsequent und hältst Aktivitäten, nächste Schritte und Prognosen im CRM aktuell.
  • Langfristige Beziehungen zu Kunden, Partnern und Empfehlungsgebern baust du aktiv auf und entwickelst daraus neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
  • Neue Marktpotenziale und attraktive Kundensegmente erkennst du frühzeitig und bringst deine Erfahrungen und Ideen aktiv in unseren Vertrieb ein.
  • Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sorgst du für eine strukturierte Übergabe an Planung und Realisierung


Dein Profil

Du passt zu uns, wenn du:

  • bereits Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb von Photovoltaik-, Energie-, Immobilien- oder vergleichbaren technischen B2B-Projekten gesammelt hast
  • den Markt für gewerbliche Photovoltaikanlagen kennst und idealerweise bereits über ein eigenes Netzwerk verfügst
  • Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundenakquise mitbringst
  • komplexere Investitionsentscheidungen und längere B2B-Sales-Cycles gewohnt bist
  • selbstständig arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und deine Ergebnisse übernimmst
  • auf Geschäftsführungs- und Entscheiderebene sicher kommunizieren kannst
  • nicht nur verkaufen, sondern langfristige Kunden- und Partnerbeziehungen aufbauen möchtest
  • unternehmerisch denkst und Lust darauf hast, neue Strukturen mitzugestalten
  • ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu potenziellen Kunden oder Multiplikationspartnern ist ein großes Plus


Warum wir?

jobs.title: AI Programme Manager - Wealth & Asset Management
AI Business Consulting Lead- Wealth & Asset Management
AI Business Analyst - Wealth & Asset Management
Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working
